overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。

full_list.title_en: Machine Learning Electronic Hamiltonian with Long-Range Effects and External Fields
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine Learning Electronic Hamiltonian with Long-Range Effects and External Fields
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional machine-learning electronic Hamiltonian (MLEH) models rely on a local-environment approximation and can miss the effects of long-range (LR) interactions and external fields. Here, we introduce MLEH-LR, a framework that incorporates these effects into Hamiltonian prediction. Benchmarks across materials with different polarizations and dimensionalities demonstrate substantial improvements in the accuracy of the predicted Hamiltonians and resulting electronic structures. MLEH-LR enables accurate, large-scale, high-throughput electronic-structure calculations, as demonstrated for zigzag boron nitride ribbons under transverse electric fields. These calculations allow us to formulate a quantitative relation describing the joint width and field dependence of the band gap and to reveal the electronic mechanisms underlying its field response. Our work provides an efficient method and tool for studying electronic structure in materials where long-range electrostatics and external fields play an important role.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Machine Learning Electronic Hamiltonian with Long-Range Effects and External Fields》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: AmorphGen: A Python package for amorphous structure generation with machine-learning and classical interatomic potentials
full_list.title_zh: AmorphGen：利用机器学习和经典原子间势生成非晶结构的 Python 包
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AmorphGen is an open-source Python package for generating and analyzing amorphous structures from a composition or a crystal. Chemically informed rules estimate initial densities and assign separation and coordination constraints. Three routes are available: random placement followed by relaxation, melt-quench from a crystal, and a hybrid route that anneals and quenches random structures. ASE provides access to classical and machine-learning potentials, with GPU batching for selected backends. Analysis tools compute coordination numbers, bond angles, rings, and X-ray or neutron structure factors for comparison with measurements. An optional interface to the FEFF code computes extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectra. For amorphous Ga2O3, TiO2 and InGaZnO4, the cation coordination numbers are close to reference models and measurements, and the X-ray structure factors reproduce the main measured peaks. The EXAFS spectra for Ga2O3 and InGaZnO4 also capture the dominant first-shell features observed experimentally. The hybrid route reduces bonding defects in SiO2 and As and builds the first sharp diffraction peak of SiO2. By simplifying ensemble generation and standardizing structural assessment, AmorphGen makes it practical to compare amorphous models across compositions, potentials, and preparation routes, and to screen new amorphous compositions.
full_list.abstract_zh: AmorphGen 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成和分析组合物或晶体的无定形结构。化学信息规则估计初始密度并分配分离和配位约束。有三种途径可供选择：随机放置然后松弛、晶体熔融淬火以及对随机结构进行退火和淬火的混合途径。 ASE 提供对经典和机器学习潜力的访问，并为选定的后端提供 GPU 批处理。分析工具计算配位数、键角、环和 X 射线或中子结构因子，以便与测量结果进行比较。 FEFF 代码的可选接口可计算扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 光谱。

full_list.title_en: Learning free energy across a differentiable temperature range by deep generative modeling
full_list.title_zh: 通过深度生成模型学习可微分温度范围内的自由能
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Free energy governs the directionality, stability, and temperature sensitivity of physical, chemical, and biological transformations. Conventional free energy calculations, such as thermodynamic integration and free energy perturbation, often have to be performed at individual temperatures and are limited by the high cost of sampling an extensive set of thermodynamic states. Here, we introduce learned temperature-differentiable free energy perturbation (TD-FEP), a deep generative framework that learns a temperature-conditioned, invertible mapping between reference and target systems through data-free, energy-based optimization. TD-FEP thereby unifies one-shot state generation and free energy calculation across a continuous temperature range. We validated TD-FEP across a broad range of applications, including isolated molecules, periodic materials, and chemical reactions.

full_list.title_en: Auditing a superconducting database built by a large language model
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Auditing a superconducting database built by a large language model
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29445v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The data on superconducting materials are published as measurements and scattered across the literature, in prose, in tables and in figures, so that gathering them into one place means reading the papers themselves. Large language models (LLMs) can read those papers, and databases built that way are appearing. The difficulty is not the reading but the trust: a number lifted out of a sentence can belong to a neighbouring compound, a computed transition temperature can be recorded without saying that it is computed, and the paper itself may be wrong. This paper describes a pipeline that extracts superconducting materials from the published literature with an LLM, checks every value against its source, and asks how far that checking goes. The pipeline proposed 19,576 records; a cascade of gates rejected 659,252 field-level extractions, 644,438 of them for want of verbatim evidence, 13,121 because the text does not attach the value to the material, and 1,693 because the source sentence reads as a calculation. The database that survives holds 3,137 material records, each with the sentence its value came from. An audit of the survivors by two independent models, on 500 records drawn in proportion to the database, shows that the gates remove the errors that are mechanical: in 93.4% of the audited records the value is in the text and the text is about the compound the record names, and 91.8% of them are measurements rather than predictions.

full_list.title_en: An equivariant classical density functional for ionic fluids at complex interfaces
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：An equivariant classical density functional for ionic fluids at complex interfaces
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting the combined effects of ionic packing and long-range electrostatics at complex interfaces is technologically important, but remains challenging without atomistic simulations. Here we present a machine-learned classical density functional for ionic fluids that combines a symmetry-adapted neural free energy for short-range correlations with explicit long-range electrostatics. Trained on three-dimensional equilibrium densities and bulk correlations of the full-Coulomb restricted primitive model, a single functional transfers to charge-patterned particles and atomically structured electrodes. Around anisotropic charged solutes, it reproduces the ionic structure and mean forces from molecular dynamics, including reversals of the bare electrostatic force. At metal electrodes, self-consistent coupling to metal atoms captures the redistribution of ionic and electrode charge and the loading-dependent capacitance enhancement produced by steps and bumps. Combined with mobilities determined independently from bulk molecular dynamics, the same functional describes the main features of charging dynamics and resolves geometry-dependent spatial relaxation. This framework can be extended to more complex ionic fluids, enabling efficient exploration of how composition and geometry control structure and response.

full_list.title_en: JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：JAX-Nano: A GPU-Accelerated Differentiable Phonon Boltzmann Transport Solver for Nanoscale Heat Transfer
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28926v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As semiconductor device dimensions approach phonon mean free paths, heat transport enters ballistic and quasi-ballistic regimes where Fourier's law becomes inadequate. The phonon Boltzmann transport equation (BTE) describes these nonequilibrium effects but presents significant computational challenges. This work introduces JAX-Nano, a GPU-accelerated, end-to-end differentiable phonon BTE solver for nanoscale heat transport. The solver integrates steady-state and transient BTE formulations within a unified finite-volume framework, supporting structured and unstructured meshes, mode-resolved transport, phonon scattering, volumetric heat generation, and multiple boundary conditions. Automatic differentiation enables gradient computation with respect to transport properties, boundary conditions, heat-generation rates, and geometric parameters without separately derived adjoint equations. Numerical predictions are validated against analytical solutions and established BTE solvers across diffusive-to-ballistic regimes. Applications to complex three-dimensional geometries are demonstrated using single-fin, double-fin, and arrayed fin field-effect transistor (FinFET) configurations. Gradient-based inverse learning enables single- and multi-parameter identification, including simultaneous recovery of mode-resolved phonon relaxation times and spatially distributed heat-generation rates in steady-state and transient problems. GPU performance and scalability are evaluated with respect to spatial resolution, angular discretization, and phonon bands, including comparisons with an MPI-based BTE solver. JAX-Nano provides a unified computational framework for three-dimensional phonon transport, automatic differentiation, and inverse parameter identification, enabling sensitivity analysis and optimization of nanoscale thermal systems.

full_list.title_en: IADR: Interface-Augmented Neural Operator for Phase-Field Mean-Curvature Flow
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：IADR: Interface-Augmented Neural Operator for Phase-Field Mean-Curvature Flow
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30153v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Allen-Cahn equation is one of the standard phase-field models for mean-curvature flow (MCF), parameterised by the diffuse-interface width ε. Practical simulations span a range of ε, so a single model covering this range is needed. PDE-specific neural operators are accurate but must be retrained at every ε; general neural operators cover ε in one model but lose the phase-field structure of the target. We introduce Interface-Augmented Diffusion-Reaction (IADR), a neural operator that addresses both shortcomings: a target network with a diffusion-and-reaction (DR) structure preserves the phase-field structure of the Allen-Cahn equation, while a hypernetwork that maps ε to the weights of this target network amortises the dependence on ε across the range. A single IADR matches the per-ε specialists on in-distribution data within the prescribed range, retains their cross-shape generalisation under both ε- and geometry-out-of-distribution shifts, and retains their compact DR target structure with millisecond-scale inference. We further establish a conditional K-step rollout error bound under consistency and stability assumptions.

full_list.title_en: Graph Neural Networks for Accurate Quasiparticle Energy Levels in Large Supercells of Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
full_list.title_zh: 过渡金属二硫化物大型超晶胞中精确准粒子能级的图神经网络
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The GW method is the one of the main workhorses of the materials science community to accurately calculate the electronic bandgap of materials, as it overcomes the gap underestimation problem from Density Functional Theory (DFT). Despite its accuracy, its computational cost becomes prohibitive when calculations have more than 10-100 atoms, which makes more difficult its use for defects, surfaces and moiré systems that demand large supercells. To overcome this problem, we developed a Graph Neural Network trained with smaller GW calculations which can make accurate predictions on large supercells at a small fraction of the computational cost. Our model uses as features the projection of DFT wavefunctions into localized atomic orbitals, while graph nodes represent the atomic positions and edges represent atom to atom distances, which captures the system geometry. We explore how to do "small AI", providing a workflow of how to create a personal and convenient dataset of GW calculations to train the model that can be applied to different materials so that the final user does not need to rely on massive datasets. We define what must be included in the training dataset to capture the physics of our objective simulation, and perform a Bayesian optimization of hyperparameters. In the case of monolayer MoS₂ with a sulfur vacancy our GNN models achieve high accuracy (MAE ranging 10 to 50 meV) with a simplified workflow applicable to other materials, accelerating accurate large electronic structure calculations.
full_list.abstract_zh: GW 方法是材料科学界精确计算材料电子带隙的主要工具之一，因为它克服了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的带隙低估问题。尽管其准确性很高，但当计算原子数超过 10-100 时，其计算成本就会变得过高，这使得其在需要大型超级晶胞的缺陷、表面和莫尔系统中的使用变得更加困难。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了一个用较小的 GW 计算训练的图神经网络，它可以以很小的计算成本对大型超级细胞进行准确的预测。

full_list.title_en: Origin of Reduced Coercive Field in ScAlN: Synergy of Structural Softening and Dynamic Atomic Correlations
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Origin of Reduced Coercive Field in ScAlN: Synergy of Structural Softening and Dynamic Atomic Correlations
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.18710v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among wurtzite-type ferroelectrics, scandium-doped aluminum nitride (ScAlN) has emerged as a leading candidate for CMOS-compatible low-voltage memory, combining strong spontaneous polarization with process compatibility. A remarkable feature of this system is the pronounced reduction of the coercive field (E_c) with increasing Sc concentration; however, its microscopic origin remains poorly understood at the atomic scale, particularly under finite temperature and applied electric fields. Here, we employ an atomistic simulation framework that integrates a density-functional-theory-accurate machine-learning force field with an equivariant neural-network-based Born effective charge model to perform large-scale electric-field-induced molecular dynamics simulations at near-first-principles accuracy. The framework correctly reproduces key experimentally observed trends, including the decrease in the c/a ratio and the monotonic reduction of E_c with increasing Sc content. Beyond static structural softening, we uncover a dynamic mechanism underlying E_c reduction. Sc atoms exhibit larger thermal vibrations and begin to displace earlier during switching, acting as dynamic triggers for polarization reversal. Moreover, the displacement correlation between Sc and Al atoms evolves systematically with composition, enhancing cooperative atomic rearrangements and lowering the effective switching barrier. These results demonstrate that E_c reduction in ScAlN arises from the synergy of structural softening and dynamic correlation evolution, providing a new perspective for designing hexagonal ferroelectrics.

full_list.title_en: CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29675v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generating new crystal materials with desirable chemical properties has long been a challenging task. Existing diffusion models operate in feature space, requiring complex diffusion architectures to model the joint distribution of atom types, coordinates, and lattice structures. This complexity increases the number of diffusion steps, leading to higher training and sampling costs. In this work, we aim to generate novel crystal materials within a time- and resource-constrained setup, where existing models are not well-suited. To address this, we propose CrysLDM, a novel latent diffusion model for 3D crystal materials, which integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a latent space, where the diffusion model operates. Since CrysLDM leverages a smooth, lower-dimensional latent space, it simplifies the generative process and accelerates both training and inference. Through extensive experiments on benchmark datasets and tasks, we show that CrysLDM generates stable and valid materials with quality comparable to state-of-the-art methods, while being significantly more efficient in terms of computational resources and time.

full_list.title_en: PACSYLLM: natural-language access to an expanded PACSY database of protein structures and chemical shifts
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：PACSYLLM: natural-language access to an expanded PACSY database of protein structures and chemical shifts
full_list.abstract: Chemical shifts are the first data obtained in protein NMR studies, and their relationship to three-dimensional structure underlies resonance assignment, secondary-structure analysis, and structure determination. In 2012, PACSY made this relationship searchable by integrating NMR structures from the Protein Data Bank (PDB), chemical shifts from the Biological Magnetic Resonance Data Bank (BMRB), and fold classifications from the Structural Classification of Proteins (SCOP). Many analyses, however, still require SQL queries or custom scripts. Here, we describe a rebuilt, quality-controlled PACSY database and PACSYLLM, a natural-language interface to its data. The database holds 11,537 PDB/BMRB chain pairs, 10,881 of them protein chains, with 7.9 million chemical shifts and 239 million atomic coordinates, 1.6 to 3.9 times the 2012 content. It also stores derived annotations for shift-based secondary-structure and torsion-angle prediction, chemical-shift re-referencing, fold classification, ensemble quality, and covalent geometry. Chemical shifts are matched to the correct molecular entity and checked against their NMR-STAR source files. PACSYLLM keeps scientific computation outside the language model: deterministic programs handle well-defined outputs, while a self-hosted 27-billion-parameter model generates one validated, read-only SQL query and summarizes the returned data. PACSYLLM answered all 26 held-out questions correctly in three repeats and answered reworded versions correctly. The database queries of six published PACSY analyses, each posed as a single natural-language request, returned the published or independently verified results.

full_list.title_en: Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anatomy of orbital and spin responses in GaAs and Si: Hall, inverse Faraday, and magneto-optical Kerr effects
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30297v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magneto-optical signals in nonmagnetic semiconductors entangle spin and orbital contributions, both in angular-momentum generation and magneto-optical detection. We calculate these contributions for electron-doped GaAs and Si using density-functional theory, linear-response theory, and a second-order density-matrix treatment of the inverse Faraday effect. At small electron doping, the intrinsic orbital Hall conductivity exceeds its spin counterpart in magnitude, while the orbital contribution to light-induced magnetization dominates over broad photon-energy ranges. We show that orbital- and spin-resolved optical Hall and polar Kerr coefficients exhibit stronger sensitivity to orbital moments than to equal spin moments. This contrast reflects direct electric-dipole coupling to orbital motion versus spin-orbit-mediated coupling to spin polarization. Consequently, Si maintains a substantial orbital magneto-optical response despite its weak spin-orbit interaction. At probe energies of 1.5 eV in GaAs and 3.0 eV in Si, the magnitude of the Kerr rotation per unit orbital moment is approximately 5 and 13 times larger than that per unit spin moment, respectively. Combining the calculated Hall conductivities and Kerr coefficients with a phenomenological drift-diffusion model yields predominantly orbital edge signals for the assumed diffusion constants and relaxation lengths. These results indicate that optical detection of induced magnetization in doped semiconductors such as GaAs and Si can be dominated by orbital signals, and therefore cannot be interpreted solely in terms of spin polarization.

full_list.title_en: DeepDOSReasoner: Physics-Grounded Reasoning for Density-of-States Prediction and Materials Discovery
full_list.title_zh: DeepDOSReasoner：用于状态密度预测和材料发现的物理推理
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting a material's behavior from its atomic structure is a longstanding goal of the physical sciences. The electronic and phonon densities of states (eDOS and phDOS) govern key electronic, optical, vibrational, and thermodynamic properties, yet their calculation using density functional theory (DFT) is costly: about 60% of Materials Project entries lack eDOS and over 80% lack phDOS. Existing crystal-to-spectrum models rely on pooled structural representations and pointwise regression, which blur spectral features and violate total-state conservation. Here we introduce DeepDOSReasoner, a physics-grounded framework that decodes spectra through atom-to-energy source attention and refines the normalized DOS through learned continuity-equation transport, enforcing nonnegativity and total-state conservation by construction. DeepDOSReasoner achieves the highest prediction accuracy across all evaluated metrics for both eDOS and phDOS, recovers element-resolved contributions without supervision, and most reliably identifies rare valence-band (VB) gaps. In a prospective screen of 8,106 uncharted materials validated by new DFT calculations, its predictions remain the most accurate among the methods evaluated, with 25 of its top 50 candidates confirmed as VB-gap materials. Three case studies spanning substituted compounds, photovoltaic chalcogenides, and a high-entropy alloy demonstrate transfer across materials classes. Ablations confirm that both stages are necessary, while the model retains comparable accuracy when trained on only 25% of the data. Predicting spectra in milliseconds enables exhaustive screening; we release predictions filling the missing eDOS for 91,405 and phDOS for 127,768 Materials Project entries. DeepDOSReasoner provides a blueprint for integrating machine learning with physical reasoning toward high-throughput spectral screening and autonomous materials discovery.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学的长期目标。电子态和声子态密度（eDOS 和 phDOS）控制着关键的电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，但使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 进行计算的成本很高：大约 60% 的材料项目条目缺乏 eDOS，超过 80% 缺乏 phDOS。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池结构表示和逐点回归，这模糊了光谱特征并违反了总状态守恒。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学的长期目标。电子态和声子态密度（eDOS 和 phDOS）控制着关键的电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，但使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 进行计算的成本很高：大约 60% 的材料项目条目缺乏 eDOS，超过 80% 缺乏 phDOS。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池结构表示和逐点回归，这模糊了光谱特征并违反了总状态守恒。在这里，我们介绍 DeepDOSReasoner，这是一个基于物理的框架，它通过原子到能量源的关注来解码光谱，并通过学习的连续性方程传输来细化归一化 DOS，通过构造强制非负性和全状态守恒。 DeepDOSReasoner 在 eDOS 和 phDOS 的所有评估指标中实现了最高的预测精度，无需监督即可恢复元素解析的贡献，并且最可靠地识别罕见的价带 (VB) 间隙。在通过新的 DFT 计算验证的 8,106 种未知材料的前瞻性筛选中，其预测仍然是评估方法中最准确的，其前 50 种候选材料中有 25 种被确认为 VB-gap 材料。涵盖取代化合物、光伏硫属化物和高熵合金的三个案例研究证明了跨材料类别的转移。消融证实这两个阶段都是必要的，而模型在仅使用 25% 的数据进行训练时仍保持相当的准确性。在几毫秒内预测光谱可以实现详尽的筛选；我们发布了预测，填补了 91,405 个材料项目条目缺失的 eDOS 和 127,768 个材料项目条目的 phDOS。 DeepDOSReasoner 提供了将机器学习与物理推理相结合以实现高通量光谱筛选和自主材料发现的蓝图。
full_list.summary: 从原子结构预测材料的行为是物理科学的长期目标。电子态和声子态密度（eDOS 和 phDOS）控制着关键的电子、光学、振动和热力学性质，但使用密度泛函理论 (DFT) 进行计算的成本很高：大约 60% 的材料项目条目缺乏 eDOS，超过 80% 缺乏 phDOS。现有的晶体到光谱模型依赖于池结构表示和逐点回归，这模糊了光谱特征并违反了总状态守恒。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入非绝热分子动力学、电子—声子耦合、Wannier/GW-BSE 和载流子输运。从摘要能确认的线索包括：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算, 热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模，以及声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“先用高精度电子结构和声子/电子—声子矩阵元建立小规模基准，再训练可迁移 Hamiltonian 或 ML 势，最后在长时间尺度非绝热 MD、输运或界面电荷转移中验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: Electric polarizabilities with phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electric polarizabilities with phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29858v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: While projector quantum Monte Carlo methods are known for producing accurate ground-state energies, the prediction of other properties that encode the electronic response to applied electric and magnetic fields has historically been challenging. In this work we demonstrate that the electric (static) polarizability tensor, which is formally a second-derivative of the energy with respect to electric fields, can be efficiently computed with phaseless auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo using a correlated sampling finite-difference strategy. With simple Hartree-Fock trial wave functions, we investigate a series of small molecules (some of which are difficult for approximate density functionals), polyacenes of increasing size, and ferrocene as a representative organometallic complex. The methodology is scalable to relatively large molecules involving thousands of basis functions, and with appropriate trial wave functions remains robust for strongly correlated electronic states, as we show for the stretched dinitrogen molecule. This work opens the door to the computation of a host of other second-order molecular properties with auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo, which will inform the ongoing search for optimal trial wave functions and extend benchmark-quality training data sets for the refinement of semi-empirical and machine learning models for quantum chemistry and molecular simulation.

full_list.title_en: Dictionary learning approach to analytic continuation of imaginary-time quantum Monte Carlo data
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dictionary learning approach to analytic continuation of imaginary-time quantum Monte Carlo data
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.19205v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Many fields of physics use quantum Monte Carlo (QMC) simulations to simulate quantum systems in imaginary-time τ and estimate imaginary-time correlation functions (ITCF). However, extracting dynamic ω-dependent quantities from ITCFs is a notoriously difficult task, known as analytic continuation (AC), that amounts to solving an exponentially ill-conditioned inverse problem. Within the AC literature, there are competing stochastic and regularized approaches, as well as an emerging collection of works using parameterized models like neural networks. Here we transcend the traditional divides between the communities, introducing the regularized stochastic optimization method (RSOM). This method reformulates AC as a dictionary learning problem, discovering a sparse dictionary to represent the solution. Our approach is motivated by the astounding results dictionary learning has produced in many scientific fields. Remarkably, RSOM discovers a sparse dictionary that maps a high-dimensional ill-conditioned inverse problem to a low-dimensional problem. We demonstrate that the method yields competitive results for common synthetic test problems as well as for authentic QMC data from the finite temperature electron gas. Due to the low dimensionality, there is reasonably finite uncertainty in the dictionary, which is leveraged to create an ad hoc post-processing estimate of the dictionary coefficients' sensitivity to perturbations. This work exposes that a dictionary exists within all stochastic and regularized methods and that dictionary learning provides a new angle of attack for future AC methods.

full_list.title_en: Autonomous Optimization of Complex Oxides for Thermochemical Fuel Production
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Autonomous Optimization of Complex Oxides for Thermochemical Fuel Production
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.06877v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Two-step thermochemical cycles for H2O and CO2 splitting offer a promising route to sustainable fuel production. Their performance depends on redox-active oxides that undergo cyclic reduction and oxidation reactions. Achieving high thermal-to-fuel conversion efficiency requires both favorable redox thermodynamics and sufficiently rapid reaction kinetics. These requirements have shifted materials design toward complex multication oxides, including mixed-cation fluorites, perovskites, and high-entropy oxides. Developing such materials requires the simultaneous optimization of their composition, defect chemistry, phase stability, and morphology. The resulting design space is difficult to explore through sequential trial and error. Thermochemical fuel production therefore provides a compelling testbed for autonomous materials design and optimization. In this study, we first examine why redox-active complex oxides are challenging to develop owing to their multidimensional phase spaces, harsh operating conditions, and competing functional targets. We then discuss how high-throughput computation, automated synthesis, characterization, and testing, together with machine learning, can be integrated into closed-loop workflows to address these challenges. Drawing on advances from broader oxide materials research, we define a capability roadmap encompassing complex-oxide synthesis, operando characterization, robotic testing, condition-aware computation, and multi-objective optimization. Finally, we identify the key experimental, computational, data, and artificial intelligence capabilities required to build self-improving optimization platforms for materials development in thermochemical fuel production

full_list.title_en: Recent advances in interfaces and durability of electrochemical cells and electrocatalytic systems
full_list.title_zh: 电化学电池和电催化系统的界面和耐久性的最新进展
full_list.abstract: Batteries, fuel cells, electrolyzers and electrocatalytic reactors are usually discussed separately, yet they tend to fail at the same kind of place: an interface. This review draws on 102 open-access articles published between 2019 and 2026, follows that thread across cells and catalysts, and collects the quantitative findings reported in them. Inorganic solid electrolytes span conductivities of 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻² S cm⁻¹ depending on class, and the sulfides that reach the highest values are prone to interface and moisture problems. Electrolyzers run at 40–90°C in liquid-alkaline, anion-exchange and proton-exchange cells and at 600–850°C in solid-oxide cells. For oxygen evolution in alkaline media, a nickel–iron oxyhydroxide needs overpotentials of 251 and 291 mV at 100 and 500 mA cm⁻² and runs for more than 300 h, and a cobalt–ferrocene framework needs about 190 mV at 10 mA cm⁻²; both are formed by reconstruction of a precatalyst during operation. Single-atom catalysts approach 100% atom utilization, yet the longest laboratory stability test quoted here, over 300 h, is under 0.4% of the 80,000 h lifetime targeted for PEM electrolyzers. In CO₂ electrolyzers, current densities above 200 mA cm⁻² are reached, but salt precipitation limits operation. We compare six catalyst families together with operando characterization and machine learning, and conclude that standardized reporting, device-relevant testing and assignment of activity to the working state now matter more than new compositions.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电池、燃料电池、电解槽和电催化反应器通常单独讨论，但它们往往在同一个地方失效：界面。本综述借鉴了 2019 年至 2026 年间发表的 102 篇开放获取文章，追踪了细胞和催化剂的线索，并收集了其中报告的定量结果。无机固体电解质的电导率范围为 10⁻⁵ 至 10⁻² S cm⁻1（具体取决于类别），达到最高值的硫化物很容易出现界面和水分问题。液碱、阴离子交换和质子交换电池中电解槽的运行温度为 40–90°C，固体氧化物电池中电解槽的运行温度为 600–850°C。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电池、燃料电池、电解槽和电催化反应器通常单独讨论，但它们往往在同一个地方失效：界面。本综述借鉴了 2019 年至 2026 年间发表的 102 篇开放获取文章，追踪了细胞和催化剂的线索，并收集了其中报告的定量结果。无机固体电解质的电导率范围为 10⁻⁵ 至 10⁻² S cm⁻1（具体取决于类别），达到最高值的硫化物很容易出现界面和水分问题。液碱、阴离子交换和质子交换电池中电解槽的运行温度为 40–90°C，固体氧化物电池中电解槽的运行温度为 600–850°C。对于碱性介质中的氧气析出，镍铁羟基氧化物在 100 和 500 mA cm-2 下需要 251 和 291 mV 的过电位，并运行超过 300 小时，而钴-二茂铁框架在 10 mA cm-2 下需要约 190 mV；两者都是通过在操作过程中重构预催化剂而形成的。单原子催化剂接近 100% 原子利用率，但此处引用的最长实验室稳定性测试超过 300 小时，低于 PEM 电解槽目标 80,000 小时寿命的 0.4%。在 CO2 电解槽中，电流密度可达到 200 mA cm⁻² 以上，但盐沉淀限制了运行。我们将六种催化剂家族与操作表征和机器学习进行比较，并得出结论，标准化报告、设备相关测试和工作状态活性分配现在比新组合物更重要。

full_list.title_en: Real-time optimization with online learning for pressure swing adsorption
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Real-time optimization with online learning for pressure swing adsorption
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30828v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Real-time optimization (RTO) of pressure swing adsorption (PSA) units requires a process model that can be evaluated many times at each decision, which favours data-driven surrogates of the cyclic steady state. A surrogate, however, represents the plant only under the conditions covered by its training data, and disturbances that are not among its inputs remain outside its description. This work presents an RTO framework for PSA in which a neural network surrogate, optimized by particle swarm, is updated online with data generated at the plant when plant and model diverge. A rigorous dynamic model of a CH₄/CO₂ separation, integrated to cyclic steady state, served as virtual plant in three scenarios. In the first, five consecutive RTO events with different objectives ran without disturbance; all constraints were satisfied and the largest deviation between surrogate and plant was 1.7 percentage points. In the second, a step in the CO₂ feed fraction from 0.40 to 0.50 reduced the CH₄ purity at the operating point in force from 92.3 to 76.9%; after the network was fine-tuned on 43 local samples, the new RTO event returned a feasible optimum with a purity of 90.3%. In the third, a progressive loss of sorbent capacity was detected by the accumulated relative deviation of the CH₄ purity from a reference, triggering retraining before any constraint violation. Samples generated across the remaining activity range led to infeasible operation, whereas samples generated at the final activity kept the purity above 92.4% after the move transient.

full_list.title_en: Using potential derivatives to reduce the cost of rectangular collocation: a general and versatile approach for computational vibrational spectroscopy without a potential energy surface
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Using potential derivatives to reduce the cost of rectangular collocation: a general and versatile approach for computational vibrational spectroscopy without a potential energy surface
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28125v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We modify the exact Cartesian kinetic energy operator, rectangular collocation approach of Manzhos and Carrington [J. Chem. Phys. 145 (2016) 224110] by using information contained in potential derivatives to decrease the number of required potential points. We show that this makes it possible to substantially reduce the number of collocation points, which is important, in particular, when energies are computed directly ab initio. Vibrational band intensities are also computed. We first demonstrate the method on Cl2CO and compare to high-accuracy Smolyak collocation calculations on an accurate potential energy surface (PES). Sub-cm-1 accuracy is obtained with a few thousand Gaussian basis functions and potential points. A spectrum computed directly from DFT energies and a comparison to GVPT2 (generalized vibrational perturbation theory) are also presented. We then consider LiCO2 as a more anharmonic case, for which a quartic force field potential is less reliable, and which also serves as a surrogate model for a catalytic system (mimicking CO2 bond weakening by charge donation). The rectangular collocation method is used to compute the spectrum of LiCO2 directly from ab initio energies and to compare to GVPT2. The method is implemented as a Claude Skill and is easily usable by anyone on any molecule. The method is a general and versatile tool for anharmonic computational vibrational spectroscopy. It does not require a PES and no coupling is neglected.

full_list.title_en: Bridging electrode preparation and electrocatalyst performance with physics-based causal AI using Bayesian Structural Causal Models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Bridging electrode preparation and electrocatalyst performance with physics-based causal AI using Bayesian Structural Causal Models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.30898v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: State-of-the-art artificial intelligence (AI) and Machine-Learning (ML) tools have not yet enabled rapid design of next-generation materials. Detailed physical understanding of how material properties affect device performance is required to advance materials development. For example, optimization of ink parameters for electrocatalysts has no known physical mathematical model and thus insights are difficult to translate from material studies to device studies. Herein, we demonstrate how to use the emerging AI tool, physics-based structural causal models (SCMs), to extract quantitative causative insights from complex heterogeneous electrochemical systems with small (n < 10), but multi-modal datasets. Our SCM quantitatively separates the role that varying the support-to-catalyst ratios and total material loadings plays on catalytic performance. The proof of concept model developed in this work enables root-cause-analysis on the cyclic voltammograms of manganese-antimony oxide oxygen reduction electrocatalysts on Vulcan carbon supports tested in alkaline media using a rotating disc electrode device configuration. Our computational causal analyses quantitatively disentangle how the catalyst performance is affected by the number of active sites versus the thickness of the electrode. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first demonstration of SCMs with physical equations applied to electrochemical materials and their performance.

full_list.title_en: A Fractional Chern Semimetal: Exact Wavefunction and Conformal Criticality
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Fractional Chern Semimetal: Exact Wavefunction and Conformal Criticality
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unlike fractional quantum Hall states in uniform Landau levels, fractional Chern insulators can host dispersive anyon bands, raising the question of what happens when the anyon gap closes. We construct an exact finite-bond-dimension tensor-network state for a fractional Chern semimetal by Gutzwiller projecting a critical parton state. This state exhibits divergent correlation lengths in charged sectors but a fractionally quantized many-body Chern number of 1/3. Although it has one electron per unit cell, its modular S and T matrices and entanglement spectrum match those of the ν=1/3 Laughlin state. We identify a (1+1)--dimensional U(3)₁× SU(3)₁ conformal field theory (CFT) governing the wavefunction norm in the infrared, an unexpected result for a state with U(1)₃ topology. The SU(3)₁ sector is a nonlinear sigma model whose Wess--Zumino level and kinetic stiffness are determined by the parton Chern number and Fubini--Study metric, respectively. Under renormalization, it flows to the conformal fixed point, with an initial distance to this fixed point controlled by the idealness of parton quantum geometry. Favorable geometry enables precise agreement with CFT predictions even on narrow cylinders.

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Dirac-like bands and weak-field transverse transport in ABA trilayer graphene
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-energy electronic structure of ABA trilayer graphene is composed of light and heavy electron branches, which can be altered by an out-of-plane displacement field. Here, we show that, depending on the values of Slonczewski-Weiss-McClure parameters, a displacement field can inflict a band edge inversion, for which we identify the inversion conditions. This inversion is accompanied by a reversal of Berry curvature and giant topological magnetic moments at the band edges. In a weak perpendicular magnetic field, those topological magnetic moments produce valley splitting, giving rise to distinct anomalous transverse electrical and thermoelectric responses. These features offer a potential route to detecting the band inversion and constraining several of the least established tight-binding parameters, such as the on-site energy shift for the dimer pair of carbons Δ^prime and the next neighbour hopping parameters γ₂ and γ₅.

full_list.title_en: High-temperature superconductivity from kinetic energy
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：High-temperature superconductivity from kinetic energy
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2411.07292v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconductivity is usually assumed to arise from attractive interaction. In this work we show that strong pairing is possible soley from kinetic energy even without a net attraction. We demonstrate a high-temperature kinetic superconductor in a simple lattice model with nearest-neighbor hopping (t) projected onto a constrained Hilbert space, analogous to the t-J model with J=0, where kinetic magnetism has been previously studied. Using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on cylinders up to width L_y=8, we find a superconducting ground state exhibiting a key difference from high-T_c cuprates: both the pairing gap and phase stiffness increase with doping (x). We find pairing gaps, determined from spin and single-electron charge gaps, exceeding 1.5t. This model can be realized within the double Kondo lattice model, relevant to bilayer nickelates, in the limit of strong inter-layer spin coupling (J_perp/t → +infty) and a balancing inter-layer repulsion (V). Importantly, the double Kondo model does not fundamentally restrict J_perp/t, suggesting the potential for high critical temperatures (T_c) approaching 0.5t. While this idealized limit predicts large pairing gaps, we show a smooth connection to the more realistic regime with J_perp sim t, albeit with a reduced pairing gap of approximately 0.1t. Assuming t sim 10³ K in typical solid state systems, our model suggests the exciting possibility of achieving T_c of hundreds of Kelvin. We propose searching for bilayer materials with reduced out-of-plane lattice constants to better approximate the conditions of our ideal model.

full_list.title_en: MagPot: A magnetoelastic potential generator for molecular dynamics simulations
full_list.title_zh: MagPot：用于分子动力学模拟的磁弹性势发生器
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29574v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetoelastic phenomena originate from the coupling between atomic displacements and magnetic degrees of freedom, and their atomistic simulation requires interatomic models in which magnetic interactions depend explicitly on interatomic distance. This paper presents MagPot, a Python program that generates Bethe-Slater parameter sets for spin-lattice molecular dynamics simulations using the SPIN package of the Large-scale Atomic/Molecular Massively Parallel Simulator (LAMMPS). From a compact set of material properties, the program determines the radial functions describing Heisenberg exchange and the dipole and quadrupole contributions of the two-ion Néel interaction. Version 1.0 supports simple-cubic, body-centred-cubic and face-centred-cubic lattices with ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic configurations. A central feature of MagPot is its modular architecture, which allows the magnetic contribution it generates to be combined additively with a broad range of compatible non-magnetic interatomic potentials. The parameterisation workflow is assessed through equation-of-state, Curie-temperature, volume-magnetostriction, pressure-dependent magnetocrystalline-anisotropy and anisotropic-magnetoelastic tests. By automating the construction of the magnetic contribution to the interatomic model, MagPot offers a straightforward and reproducible route from material properties to LAMMPS-ready magnetic interactions, facilitating large-scale atomistic simulations of magnetoelasticity and magnetostriction, as well as physical phenomena associated with magnon-phonon coupling.

full_list.title_en: Minimal Three-Band Model and d-Wave Superconductivity in La₄Ni₃O₈
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Minimal Three-Band Model and d-Wave Superconductivity in La₄Ni₃O₈
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Motivated by the recent observation of ambient-pressure superconductivity in Pr- and Y-substituted La₄Ni₃O₈, we combined density-functional theory (DFT), dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT), random phase approximation (RPA), and fluctuation exchange approximation (FLEX) methods to study its electronic structure and superconducting pairing symmetry. DFT band analysis indicates that the low-energy states are mainly dominated by three Ni-3dₓ^₂₋y^₂ orbitals with weak d-p hybridization. Multi-orbital DMFT calculations yield an average dₓ^₂₋y^₂ filling of about 0.87, close to the optimal value for infinite-layer nickelates. By comparing the DMFT results of dₓ^₂₋y^₂ only and full Ni-3d models, we find that their electronic properties are almost completely consistent, demonstrating the effectiveness of the simplified dₓ^₂₋y^₂ model. RPA and FLEX calculations based on this model consistently indicate a dominant dₓ^₂₋y^₂-wave pairing instability. These results establish La₄Ni₃O₈ as a system whose electronic structure closely resembles that of hole-doped cuprates, suggesting that the electronic pockets near the Γ- and A-points, which are characteristic of infinite-layer nickelates, may not be essential for superconductivity. The calculated superconducting transition temperature (T_C) is approximately 10,K, in good agreement with experimental observations.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30917v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Atomically precise nanographenes combine tunable electronic topology with localized, coherent spin states, making them candidate platforms for molecular quantum technologies. This review examines the multiscale theoretical framework governing these systems: the hierarchy of computational methods for describing magnetic properties, the substrate-molecule interface, on-surface synthetic kinetics, and supramolecular self-assembly. We highlight how density functional theory, automated reaction-path discovery, and spin-aware machine-learned interatomic potentials connect static electronic structure to mesoscale dynamics, and how magnetic exchange, optical excitations, and spin transport can be predicted before synthesis.

full_list.title_en: Quantum Hall Effect in a 3D Cross-Dimensional Quantum Anomalous Hall System
full_list.title_zh: 3D 跨维量子反常霍尔系统中的量子霍尔效应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28751v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We systematically investigate cross-dimensional transport and the resulting quantum Hall effect in 3D quantum anomalous Hall effect systems, which are constructed by coupling two Weyl-semimetal Hamiltonians. Our study unveils that the system hosts highly anisotropic surface states and chiral modes, leading to rich quantum Hall responses. Crucially, we clarify how magnetic fields applied along three high-symmetry directions dictate the evolution of the Chern numbers, chiral modes, and Hall responses. We discover that chiral modes along different directions can originate from distinct mechanisms, giving rise to various magnetic modulation characteristics. Furthermore, we unveil the breakdown of the conventional Chern-number-based bulk-boundary correspondence under magnetic fields, where the Chern numbers alone fail to fully characterize the evolution of the chiral states. This anomalous behavior is attributed to the unique momentum-space distributions of surface bands. These insights are further validated numerically through multi-terminal Hall transport simulations. Our findings expand the understanding of magnetic-field-driven mechanisms in 3D topological systems and provide deeper insights into the interplay between quantized Hall effects and Chern numbers in 3D systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们系统地研究了 3D 量子反常霍尔效应系统中的跨维度输运和由此产生的量子霍尔效应，该系统是通过耦合两个 Weyl 半金属哈密顿量构建的。我们的研究表明，该系统具有高度各向异性的表面态和手性模式，从而产生丰富的量子霍尔响应。至关重要的是，我们阐明了沿三个高对称方向施加的磁场如何决定陈数、手性模式和霍尔响应的演变。我们发现沿不同方向的手性模式可能源自不同的机制，从而产生各种磁调制特性。此外，我们揭示了磁场下传统的基于陈数的体边界对应的分解，其中陈数本身无法完全表征手性态的演化。

full_list.title_en: Symmetry classes of hyperdeterminant wavefunctions: Application to phase transitions between a bosonic fractional Chern insulator and superfluids
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Symmetry classes of hyperdeterminant wavefunctions: Application to phase transitions between a bosonic fractional Chern insulator and superfluids
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28276v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a phase transition between a superfluid phase and a fractional Chern insulator phase in a hard-core boson model on the honeycomb lattice using symmetric hyperdeterminant (Hdet) wavefunctions. Combining projective symmetry group analysis with variational Monte Carlo, we construct and optimize Hdet states in various symmetry classes. Based on the associated effective theories, we show that different symmetry classes, i.e., representations of the projective symmetry group, describe specific quantum phases. Compared with traditional fermionic parton construction, the symmetric Hdet wavefunctions are shown to improve microscopics significantly, allowing quantitative investigation of quantum phase diagrams. We argue that, in contrast with the common belief, this putative continuous phase transition is described by a fluctuating SU(2)_g gauge field coupling with four Dirac nodes forming two SU(2)_g doublets (i.e., N_f=2 QCD).

full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Valence band, electron correlation, and possible temperature dependent change in the electronic structure near E_F of a candidate of ambient-pressure nickelate superconductors Sr₃Ni₂O₅Cl₂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30088v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Photoemission spectroscopy (PES) studies of Sr₃Ni₂O₅Cl₂ (Sr3252), a candidate ambient-pressure bilayer nickelate superconductor, have been performed to investigate the electronic structure. Valence band spectra, which are compared with DFT and DFT+U calculations, reveal dominant Ni 3d t₂g-derived states located around 0.6 eV binding energy with a shoulder around 0.2 eV that can be attributed to states with a dominant Ni 3d₃z₂₋ᵣ₂ character. The overall valence band shape is better reproduced by the simulated spectrum of DFT+U (= 3 eV), providing an experimental estimation of the strength of electron correlation. High-resolution PES near the Fermi level (E_F) exhibits marked temperature dependence, which cannot be fully understood by a broadening due to coupling of a photo-hole to phonons alone and suggests change in electronic structure. The results provide fundamental electronic structure information of Sr3252, which is useful to further explore the superconductivity of Sr3252.

full_list.title_en: Approximating thermodynamic equilibrium observables of quasi one-dimensional magnetic molecules and chains by thermal DMRG - a user perspective
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Approximating thermodynamic equilibrium observables of quasi one-dimensional magnetic molecules and chains by thermal DMRG - a user perspective
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.24608v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Density matrix renormalization group methods or tensor network methods in general can not only be used to determine ground states but also to evaluate thermal equilibrium properties. Although convergence is superior for one-dimensional quantum spin systems with nearest neighbor exchange and open boundary conditions, the hope is that these methods can as well be employed to approximate magnetic observables of magnetic molecules with more complex interaction patterns. Here, we assume the position of a user and study the accuracy that can realistically be achieved for several archetypical quasi one-dimensional structures using the TenPy suite. In our study, we aim at systems that are too large for exact diagonalization or Krylov space methods.

full_list.title_en: Indentation-induced polar domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave semiconductor EuTe4
full_list.title_zh: 压痕诱导的电荷密度波半导体EuTe4极性畴重构
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30121v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling polar domains in conducting materials by external fields could unlock polarization-based electronic functionalities, yet remains experimentally challenging. While mechanical actuation driven by local strain, stress, or strain gradients has been proposed as an external-voltage-free route, its experimental demonstration in relatively conducting polar materials remains limited. Here we demonstrate mechanically induced polar-domain reconfiguration in the charge-density-wave (CDW) semiconductor EuTe4 at room temperature, whose resistivity is on the order of 10 mΩcm. Polarized-light microscopy and second-harmonic-generation measurements reveal CDW-induced in-plane polarization domains with an approximately 90 ^circ domain configuration. Local indentation with a sim1 μm-apex-radius needle reconfigures these domains, producing write/erase-like changes in wedge-shaped regions. These results establish local mechanical-field domain engineering in a relatively conducting CDW semiconductor, with possible contributions from both ferroelastic-like and flexoelectric mechanisms.
full_list.abstract_zh: 通过外加电场控制导电材料中的极性畴可以实现基于极化的电子功能，但仍存在实验上的挑战。虽然人们已提出由局部应变、应力或应变梯度驱动的机械致动作为一种无需外加电压的途径，但其在相对导电的极性材料中的实验示范仍然有限。本文展示了在室温下，电荷密度波（CDW）半导体EuTe4中机械诱导的极性畴重构，其电阻率在10 mΩcm量级。偏振光显微镜和二阶谐波产生测量揭示了CDW诱导的平面内极化畴，其畴构型约为90 ^circ。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 通过外加电场控制导电材料中的极性畴可以实现基于极化的电子功能，但仍存在实验上的挑战。虽然人们已提出由局部应变、应力或应变梯度驱动的机械致动作为一种无需外加电压的途径，但其在相对导电的极性材料中的实验示范仍然有限。本文展示了在室温下，电荷密度波（CDW）半导体EuTe4中机械诱导的极性畴重构，其电阻率在10 mΩcm量级。偏振光显微镜和二阶谐波产生测量揭示了CDW诱导的平面内极化畴，其畴构型约为90 ^circ。使用尖端半径为1 μm的针头进行局部压痕，可重构这些畴，在楔形区域产生类似写入/擦除的变化。这些结果在相对导电的CDW半导体中建立了局部机械场畴工程，其中可能存在类铁弹性和挠曲电性机制的贡献。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《压痕诱导的电荷密度波半导体EuTe4极性畴重构》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: High-Throughput Screening of Phononic Bandgap in Experimentally Realized Materials
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：High-Throughput Screening of Phononic Bandgap in Experimentally Realized Materials
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30344v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Materials with a phonon band gap offer a unique mechanism to restrict phonon scattering, making them promising candidates for developing functional materials for targeted thermal applications. Unlocking this mechanism across broad material classes requires systematic exploration, but first-principles methods and experiments are too expensive. Here, we used the universal machine-learning interatomic potential to quantify phonons and thermodynamic properties. We validated the accuracy of machine-learning-calculated results by comparing them with density-functional theory. We screened 154,879 materials and performed phonon calculations for 42,347 thermodynamically stable and experimentally observed compounds. We then performed phonon band gap analysis for dynamically stable materials and identified 11,176 materials with a phononic gap, including 10,960 materials with optical-optical gaps and 270 with acoustic-optical gaps. We also analyzed the lattice thermal conductivity of materials with phonon band gaps to identify candidates with acoustic-optical gaps and low thermal conductivity. Finally, by solving the linearized phonon Boltzmann equation from first principles, we demonstrate low room-temperature lattice thermal conductivities in three Li-metal binaries.

full_list.title_en: Aharonov-Bohm oscillations in transport through interacting quantum dots
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Aharonov-Bohm oscillations in transport through interacting quantum dots
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30753v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate electronic transport through a two-terminal Aharonov-Bohm interferometer with two quantum dots in the presence of finite intra-dot Coulomb interactions. With the help of a diagrammatic technique, we derive, within linear perturbation theory in the tunnelling-coupling strength, analytic expressions for the occupations, current, and interferometric visibility in terms of a coherence measure that involves the sum of four off-diagonal elements of the reduced density matrix. The latter are calculated numerically from a master equation for arbitrary settings of the system parameters. For some symmetric setups, we obtain closed-form expressions for the linear conductance. We systematically analyse the impact of a finite Coulomb interaction on the interferometric visibility, and reveal a rapid suppression of destructive interference upon breaking of system symmetries. Our results are supported by alternative methods, including the TraSPI method.

full_list.title_en: All-in-one Spintronic Sensory Neurons for Magnetic Edge Intelligence
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：All-in-one Spintronic Sensory Neurons for Magnetic Edge Intelligence
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30740v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic fields enable non-contact sensing through nonmagnetic materials, offering opportunities for magnetic edge intelligence in autonomous recognition, navigation, and control. However, directly converting magnetic stimuli into neural spikes for local neuromorphic processing remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate an all-in-one spintronic sensory neuron (SSN) based on spin-transfer-torque magnetic tunnel junctions (STT-MTJs) fabricated using a 40-nm magnetoresistive random-access memory (MRAM) process. By exploiting magnetic-field-modulated stochastic switching, the SSN enables probability-based sensing with an electrically tunable sensitive field window, allowing adaptive operation across different magnetic-field ranges without structural modification. This tunability alleviates the fixed sensitivity-range constraint of conventional tunneling magnetoresistance sensing, providing an accessible sensing range of +/-40 mT with an average probability sensitivity of 2.91%/mT. Importantly, the same stochastic switching process directly transduces magnetic stimuli into binary spike trains, integrating magnetic sensing, nonlinear rate encoding, and spike generation within a single nanoscale device. The resulting sigmoidal spike-rate response enables magnetic-field encoding, experimentally validated using the Neural Engineering Framework. Using experimentally characterized device responses, a simulated 10 x 10 SSN array achieves 90.7% accuracy in contactless magnetic-trajectory recognition with optimized encoding, approaching the software baseline. These results establish a scalable, MRAM-compatible approach to unifying programmable magnetic sensing and neural encoding for sensor-native edge intelligence.

full_list.title_en: Altermagnetism of MnSiN2 and MnGeN2 in a wurtzite-based crystal structure
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Altermagnetism of MnSiN2 and MnGeN2 in a wurtzite-based crystal structure
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30865v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Based on symmetry analysis, the Pna2₁ wurtzite-based crystal structure with Mn as a magnetic group-II element, MnSiN2 and MnGeN2 belong to the class of altermagnets because spin-up and spin-down Mn in the unit cell are related by rotation or mirror plane type operations rather than inversion or translation. Spin polarized density functional theory calculations and quasiparticle self-consistent (QS) GW calculations support the symmetry analysis and identify the lowest-energy spin configuration as Pna'2₁' in agreement with neutron diffraction data. The altermagnetic band splittings allowed for the three different antiferromagnetic ordering patterns are reported and symmetry analyzed. Additionally, spin wave dispersions, chiral magnon spltting, and Neel temperature estimates from the mean-field and random-phase approximations are provided, as well as calculations of the optical dielectric function using the Bethe-Salpeter Equation method. MnSiN2 exhibits both Wannier-type excitons with N-p to Si-s transition character and charge-transfer Frenkel-type excitons with hole on N-p and electron on Mn-d orbital character.

full_list.title_en: Bogoliubov-picture thermofield dynamics in anharmonic environments
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Bogoliubov-picture thermofield dynamics in anharmonic environments
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29427v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Thermofield dynamics (TFD) describes finite-temperature quantum relaxation through a purified wavefunction, without sampling thermally populated initial states. For harmonic environments, TFD is typically combined with a thermal Bogoliubov transformation to obtain a compact wavefunction representation. This transformation can also be useful for anharmonic baths, but preparing the corresponding thermal state in the transformed representation poses additional numerical challenges. Here, we explore TFD approaches tailored to anharmonic potentials and compatible with efficient tensor network methods for quantum propagation. We show that the conceptually appealing route of converting a harmonic-reference thermal state into the target anharmonic state by imaginary-time propagation can be numerically ill-conditioned. As a practical alternative, we formulate a multilayer multiconfiguration time-dependent Hartree (ML-MCTDH) protocol that separates thermal-state preparation from the harmonic-reference Bogoliubov transformation. We prepare the thermal purification in the bare representation and then apply finite-basis Bogoliubov unitaries to the physical--auxiliary mode pairs. For independent bath modes, direct construction of the thermal amplitude provides a complementary initialization procedure. We illustrate this protocol through vibrational relaxation and spatial-superposition decoherence of a harmonic subsystem coupled to a Morse-oscillator bath. We find non-monotonic energy relaxation, shifts in the dominant resonant response, and oscillatory energy exchange at zero and finite temperature. For decoherence, we recover the expected harmonic-bath scaling and find a pronounced non-monotonic dependence of the decay rate on anharmonicity at finite temperature in a low-frequency model, with a weaker dependence in a high-frequency model.

full_list.title_en: Coupled Altermagnetic and Valley Physics in Monolayer VBiSe₃
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Coupled Altermagnetic and Valley Physics in Monolayer VBiSe₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30649v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The interplay of compensated magnetism, spin--orbit coupling (SOC), and valley degrees of freedom provides a promising route toward spin--valley control without conventional ferromagnetism. Here, using first-principles calculations combined with Wannier-based analysis, we reveal coupled altermagnetic and valley physics in monolayer VBiSe₃. In the absence of SOC, the compensated Néel antiferromagnetic state, whose opposite-spin V sublattices are related only by mirror operations, exhibits momentum-dependent spin splitting with a characteristic i-wave altermagnetic texture. Upon inclusion of SOC, the conduction-band states develop anisotropic Rashba-like spin splitting together with a sizable K/K' valley splitting of about 112.2~meV. Orbital analysis and an effective SOC Hamiltonian identify the hybridization between SOC-active Se-pₓ,y states and predominantly V-dz^₂ conduction-band states as an important microscopic origin of the valley splitting. The two valleys carry Berry curvature of the same sign but different magnitude, unlike the opposite-sign pattern of conventional valley Hall systems, so the large valley splitting, rather than a valley Hall effect, offers a possible route to valley-selective carrier occupation by gating. Moreover, a modest -1% biaxial compressive strain drives the system into a quasi-half-valley-metallic state with valley-polarized electrons and non-valley-polarized holes. These results establish monolayer VBiSe₃ as a promising platform for coupled altermagnetic, spin--orbit, and valley phenomena with strain-tunable electronic states.

full_list.title_en: Curling Superconducting Vortices by Nematic Fluxon-Skyrmion Interaction
full_list.title_zh: 通过向列流子-斯格明子相互作用卷曲超导涡旋
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Superconducting vortex represents a topological entity in type-II superconductors, where the prototypical manifestation of such a macroscopic quantum state holds great promise for applications in future quantum technologies. Deterministic control of the vortex dynamics at the nanoscale is central to enhance superconductors' critical thresholds and design next-generation superconducting quantum devices. However, it is still scientifically challenging due to the intrinsic nature of the vortex pinning landscapes in superconductors. Here, we observe an even-in-field Hall-like signal with about two order of magnitude enhancement in a type-II superconductor/chiral magnet heterostructure, which confines to the field-temperature window where the flux flow coexists with magnetic skyrmions. The polarity of such a giant even-in-field transverse response reverses between orthogonal current directions, suggesting an on-track vortex flow driven by a nematic fluxon-skyrmion interaction analyzed via the extended vortex-viscosity tensor. More critically, a deterministic manipulation of skyrmions at the nanoscale within the hybrid system enables selective and reversible controls over the dissipative behavior and therefore the reconfigurable fluxon transport, mimic the precise control of curling stone in winter Olympic, thereby opening a new avenue towards the exploration of programmable topological and superconducting quantum devices.

full_list.title_en: Electric Field Assisted Charge Transfer Mediated Electronic Coupling in Ferromagnetic/Multiferroic Hetero-structure
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Electric Field Assisted Charge Transfer Mediated Electronic Coupling in Ferromagnetic/Multiferroic Hetero-structure
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30598v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The strongly coupled ferromagnet-multiferroic material could be a better alternative to complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS) based data storage device or rather lone multiferroic oxide materials because it offers the electric field controlled conductivity and large magnetisation at the interfaces, but choosing a proper system is still very much challenging. In the present scenario, an interionic charge transfer from Co ion to Fe ion via oxygen is observed at the interfacial region of LaCoO3 (LCO)/BiFeO3 (BFO) grown on SrTiO3 substrate, leading to induce multivalency in Co, Fe ion and also induces exchange biasing in the system. The charge transferring between Co and Fe ions gets further enhanced by electric biasing across the bilayer in the low temperature region, which affects the polarisation behaviour of BFO layer. This confirms the electronic coupling between the ferromagnetic LCO and the multiferroic BFO layers, useful for the making of voltage-controlled magnetic anisotropy (VCMA) systems.

full_list.title_en: Finite-size reversal of a multiparticle correction to local spin spectra in a flux-disordered Kitaev honeycomb model
full_list.title_zh: 通量无序 Kitaev 蜂窝模型中局部自旋谱多粒子校正的有限尺寸反转
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29070v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A spin flip in the Kitaev honeycomb model changes the flux background and therefore the Hamiltonian seen by the matter fermions. Can a one-particle approximation with the correct total spin intensity nevertheless misestimate the depth of a depression in the local spin spectrum? We test this question in a frozen, flux-disordered ensemble by retaining the actual one-particle transition energies and relative spectral weights after the spin flip, then rescaling those weights to match the full intensity. We measure the depression by subtracting the central intensity from the average at two flanking frequencies. For spin-created states with odd final quasiparticle number and nonzero one-particle weight, restoring multiparticle weight shallows the depression on 24 sites and deepens it on both 1,536-site shapes and the 3,456- and 6,144-site tori, as judged by the median paired correction at each of two energy resolutions. For these states, the one-particle approximation overestimates the mean dip depth by about 16-18% on 24 sites and underestimates it by 33-56% in the 6,144-site sample. Extrapolating from 24 sites would therefore give the wrong sign for this correction on those four larger tori under the same disorder prescription.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在Kitaev蜂窝模型中，自旋翻转会改变磁通背景，从而改变物质费米子所看到的哈密顿量。具有正确总自旋强度的单粒子近似是否仍会错误估计局部自旋谱中凹陷的深度？我们在一个冻结的、磁通无序的系综中检验这个问题，方法是保留自旋翻转后的实际单粒子跃迁能量和相对谱权重，然后对这些权重进行重新标度，使其与全强度相匹配。我们通过从两个侧翼频率的平均值中减去中心强度来测量凹陷。

full_list.title_en: Giant magnetic anisotropy in layered polar metal Sr₃Co₂O₇ from Charge-disproportionation orbital unquenching
full_list.title_zh: 电荷歧化轨道未淬灭层状极性金属 Sr₃Co2O₇ 中的巨磁各向异性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29742v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crystal-field quenching usually suppresses orbital angular momentum and limits magnetic anisotropy in transition-metal oxides. Here we identify charge disproportionation as a route to giant magnetocrystalline anisotropy in the layered polar metal Sr₃Co₂O₇. First-principles calculations reveal an energy preference of 234.0 meV per cell for in-plane [110] magnetization over [001]. Charge disproportionation and the associated polar displacement reconstruct the local cobalt crystal fields, creating inequivalent sites with distinct orbital hierarchies. This reconstruction enables a strongly directional orbital response, particularly at the displaced cobalt site, where orbital angular momentum is recovered for in-plane magnetization. Spin--orbit coupling converts this response into a large magnetic anisotropic energy. In the centrosymmetric reference, the orbital moments remain nearly quenched and the anisotropy is strongly reduced. A local Green-function and orbital-moment analysis connects the large energy scale to orbital unquenching, while the conventional second-order contribution is small within the adopted approximation. These results identify charge-disproportionation-driven orbital reconstruction as a design principle for large anisotropy and motivate layered perovskites and magnetic polar metals as platforms in the search for rare-earth-free permanent magnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 晶体场猝灭通常会抑制轨道角动量，并限制过渡金属氧化物中的磁各向异性。本文中，我们确定电荷歧化是层状极性金属Sr₃Co₂O₇中产生巨磁晶各向异性的一种途径。第一性原理计算表明，对于面内[110]磁化相对于[001]磁化，每个晶胞的能量偏好为234.0 meV。电荷歧化和相关的极性位移重构了局部钴晶体场，形成了具有不同轨道层次的不等价位点。这种重构实现了强方向性轨道响应，特别是在位移钴位点，该位点的轨道角动量在面内磁化时得以恢复。自旋-轨道耦合将这种响应转化为较大的磁各向异性能。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 晶体场猝灭通常会抑制轨道角动量，并限制过渡金属氧化物中的磁各向异性。本文中，我们确定电荷歧化是层状极性金属Sr₃Co₂O₇中产生巨磁晶各向异性的一种途径。第一性原理计算表明，对于面内[110]磁化相对于[001]磁化，每个晶胞的能量偏好为234.0 meV。电荷歧化和相关的极性位移重构了局部钴晶体场，形成了具有不同轨道层次的不等价位点。这种重构实现了强方向性轨道响应，特别是在位移钴位点，该位点的轨道角动量在面内磁化时得以恢复。自旋-轨道耦合将这种响应转化为较大的磁各向异性能。在中心对称的参考系中，轨道角动量几乎保持猝灭状态，各向异性大大降低。局部格林函数和轨道角动量分析将大能量尺度与轨道角动量未猝灭联系起来，而在所采用的近似中，传统的二阶贡献很小。这些结果将电荷歧化驱动的轨道重构确定为大各向异性的设计原理，并推动了层状钙钛矿和磁性极性金属作为寻找不含稀土的永磁体的平台。

full_list.title_en: Gyroidal Magnetic Order with Weyl Magnons
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Gyroidal Magnetic Order with Weyl Magnons
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30374v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The gyroid, a triply periodic minimal surface found widely in nature and materials, has remained largely unexplored as a design principle for magnetic order. We introduce gyroidal magnetic order on the hyperoctagon lattice, the skeletal network of the gyroid, in which each magnetic moment points along the local C₃ axis that coincides with the local normal to the gyroid surface. The resulting noncoplanar spin texture constitutes a direct magnetic imprint of the gyroid geometry. We show that this order can be stabilized by single-ion anisotropy, the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, or the symmetric off-diagonal Γ interaction combined with the Kitaev interaction, and remains robust against quantum fluctuations. Its magnon spectrum hosts symmetry-enforced pseudospin-1 and pseudospin-1/2 Weyl points that, unlike their electronic counterparts, persist under symmetry-allowed perturbations. Our results establish the gyroid as a geometric platform for magnetic order and symmetry-enforced topological magnon excitations.

full_list.title_en: Interface-Engineered Piezoelectricity and Electromechanical Coupling in Two-Dimensional van der Waals Heterostructures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Interface-Engineered Piezoelectricity and Electromechanical Coupling in Two-Dimensional van der Waals Heterostructures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interfaces between dissimilar two-dimensional (2D) materials provide a route to engineer electromechanical responses that are not intrinsic to the individual constituent layers. Here, we use high-throughput density functional theory (DFT) calculations to investigate 461 van der Waals heterostructures constructed from 57 2D monolayers and establish a materials-design framework linking work-function mismatch, interfacial charge redistribution, dipole formation, and strain-dependent electromechanical response. We find that heterostructure formation generates out-of-plane interfacial dipoles via charge redistribution between the constituent layers, while biaxial in-plane strain systematically modulates them. The resulting heterostructures exhibit two distinct regimes: metallic interfaces with strain-tunable interfacial dipoles and semiconducting heterostructures with well-defined piezoelectric responses. For the latter, Berry-phase (BP) calculations independently validate the charge-density-difference (CDD) approach, which is generally applicable to all representative systems, with piezoelectric coefficients calculated via two methods agreeing to within 10%. full_list.title_en: Interstitial Magnetoelectricity in Altermagnetic Electrides
full_list.title_zh: 交变磁性电子化合物中的间隙磁电
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28504v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electrides and altermagnets are two distinct yet intriguing classes of quantum materials, characterized by interstitial anionic electrons and nonrelativistic spin splitting, respectively. The recent prediction of Stoner-instability-driven altermagnetic electride provides a natural bridge between these two fields. Here, we investigate the magnetoelectric response and its related spin-polarized transport in the altermagnetic electride Zr₂N monolayer. Using the tight-binding Hubbard model and first-principles calculations, we find that the electric field can break the magnetic compensation between the two interstitial anionic electrons, inducing a finite net magnetization and giving rise to an interstitial electron mediated magnetoelectric response. The magnetoelectric response is further demonstrated through the electrical control of spin conductivity. Our results reveal a magnetoelectric effect in altermagnetic electrides, paving a way towards electride-based spintronic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子化合物和交变磁体是两种不同但有趣的量子材料，其特征分别是间隙阴离子电子和非相对论性自旋分裂。最近对斯托纳不稳定性驱动的交变磁电子的预测为这两个领域之间提供了天然的桥梁。在这里，我们研究了互变磁性电子化合物 Zr2N 单层中的磁电响应及其相关的自旋极化输运。利用紧束缚哈伯德模型和第一性原理计算，我们发现电场可以打破两个间隙阴离子电子之间的磁补偿，诱导有限的净磁化强度并产生间隙电子介导的磁电响应。通过自旋传导性的电控制进一步证明了磁电响应。

full_list.title_en: Janus Asymmetry Unlocks Rashba Spintronics and Chiral Phononics in Two-Dimensional Carbo-Chalcogenides
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Janus Asymmetry Unlocks Rashba Spintronics and Chiral Phononics in Two-Dimensional Carbo-Chalcogenides
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30767v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spintronics and chiral phononics offer complementary routes for nanoscale control, yet realizing both functionalities within a common two-dimensional platform remains challenging. Here, using extensive first-principles calculations, we show that Janus asymmetry simultaneously drives both effects in transition-metal carbo-chalcogenides (JTMCCs) along two chemically distinct routes, through either chalcogen or transition-metal substitution. Remarkably, both Janus routes yield giant Rashba responses, with α_Rapprox2 eV Å in Ta₂CSSe and NbTaCS₂, exceeding those reported for Mo/W-based Janus transition-metal dichalcogenides. Furthermore, Janus asymmetry lifts the degeneracy of opposite-chirality phonons, producing splittings as large as approx28 cm⁻¹. More strikingly, asymmetry generates chiral carbon vibrations that were achiral in the centrosymmetric parent compounds, with splittings reaching approx8 cm⁻¹. Finally, we show external electric fields tunability over Rashba strength and chiral-phonon splittings, providing a common control knob for electronic spin and lattice angular momentum. Our work offers a unified strategy for realizing spintronic and chiral phononic in two-dimensional materials.
