full_list.title_en: Liouvillian Quasiparticle Spectroscopy
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Liouvillian Quasiparticle Spectroscopy
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30441v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quasiparticles play a central role in understanding closed quantum many-body systems, as they reduce complex many-body problems to effective single-particle descriptions and connect directly to spectroscopic measurements. In open quantum systems, the interplay between coherent dynamics and dissipation gives rise to unique phenomena, such as the Liouvillian skin effect and strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking. This raises a fundamental question: how can the quasiparticle picture be extended to open quantum systems to account for such phenomena and enable the experimental probing of quasiparticle spectra? Here we introduce coherent and incoherent Liouvillian quasiparticles, defined by responses to perturbations acting on one side and both sides of the density matrix, respectively. We propose spectroscopy protocols that couple the system to auxiliary levels, either coherently or via a dissipative pulse, to measure the corresponding complex quasiparticle energies. Numerical simulations of Liouvillians with skin effects validate these protocols, revealing nontrivial spectral winding associated with unidirectional transport in real space. Notably, coherent and incoherent quasiparticles can propagate in opposite directions within the same system. Furthermore, in models exhibiting weak and strong-to-weak U(1) spontaneous symmetry breaking, our results unveil gapless Nambu-Goldstone modes in the coherent and incoherent quasiparticle spectra, respectively; the other quasiparticle spectrum remains gapped in each case. Our work provides a unified framework for theoretically describing and experimentally probing coherent and incoherent quasiparticles in open quantum many-body systems.

full_list.title_en: MagTrace: Tracing magnetic order through the evolving scientific literature
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：MagTrace: Tracing magnetic order through the evolving scientific literature
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28338v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Much of the research on magnetic materials starts from their magnetic order, but confirming it from the papers by hand can take hours, and curated databases can be incomplete and outdated. In this work, we build MagTrace, a language model agent that, given only a material's name, searches four literature databases, reads open access full text and reports the magnetic orders the current literature supports, each with a confidence score and citations a reader can check. We evaluate its performance on 18 materials against an answer key complied from published papers, compared with two other conditions that vary in level of retrieval. On a score from 0 to 1 that combines correctness, detail, whether the most confident order is current, and citation integrity, MagTrace scores 0.839; the same underlying language model scores 0.676 given the abstracts from one literature search and 0.548 answering from memory. With a single search, the model finds the right kind of order but omits the propagation vector, which describes how the pattern repeats through the material's crystal structure, in 85% of its orders. From memory, the model often cites titles that lead to no indexed paper (for 25% of the orders we could check), and when a cited paper exists and has an abstract, the abstract contradicts the claim for 17% of those citations, against 7% for MagTrace.

full_list.title_en: Manipulation of Ferroelectric Polarization Under Near-Gap Light
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Manipulation of Ferroelectric Polarization Under Near-Gap Light
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30359v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Noncontacting light control of ferroelectric (FE) order has been receiving extensive interest in condensed matter physics. In this work, we investigate near-resonant light irradiation that induces structure-dependent photoexcited carrier density along the transition pathway. We combine a minimal Rice-Mele model containing intersite density-density correlations with ab initio calculations for realistic materials such as GeTe and SnTe. If the photon energy is below-gap without carrier excitation, only off-resonant scattering occurs and the FE order tends to be diminished. Slightly increasing photon energy at the near-gap regime would lead to a centrosymmetric non-polar (NP) to FE phase transition, which is not thermally accessible in conventional pressure-temperature phase diagram. This is in contrast to the well-above-gap light situation that tends to suppress the FE order under a fixed amount of photoexcitation. We apply phenomenological Landau theory and show that they belong to the continuous and first-order phase transitions, respectively. The occupation constrained calculations suggest that these reversible NP-FE phase transitions could be triggered under moderate light fluence. Our mechanism provides a potential route to reversible light-stabilized polar phases with reduced lattice heating and marginal lattice damages.

full_list.title_en: Multiorbital driving of quantum geometric nonlinear transport in oxide interfaces
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Multiorbital driving of quantum geometric nonlinear transport in oxide interfaces
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28213v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry plays a relevant role in determining the intrinsic non-linear transport properties of low-dimensional electron systems. Here, we theoretically investigate the quantum geometric contribution to the non-linear conductivity in SrTiO₃-based two-dimensional electron gases, comparing the prototypical (001) and (111) crystallographic interface orientations. Using a multi-orbital tight-binding approach, we uncover the crucial role of the multiband electronic structure in determining the quantum-geometric contribution to nonlinear transport. In particular, we show how the hybridization of t₂g orbitals near avoided band crossings shapes the momentum-space distribution of the band-normalized quantum metric and the resulting nonlinear conductivity. Furthermore, we reveal a strong dependence on crystal orientation: while the (001) interface exhibits sharp peak-and-dip features confined around Lifshitz transitions, the trigonal symmetry of the (111) interface promotes strong orbital mixing. Our results highlight how the interplay between orbital hybridization and crystallographic orientation gives rise to distinct quantum-geometric nonlinear transport responses in oxide interfaces.

full_list.title_en: Perfect Spin-to-Charge Signal Conversion via Inverse Spin Hall Effect in a Superconductor
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Perfect Spin-to-Charge Signal Conversion via Inverse Spin Hall Effect in a Superconductor
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30781v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-to-charge conversion is central to spintronics, but conventional spin Hall mechanisms are intrinsically limited by the small spin Hall angle. Here we show that superconductivity can overcome this limitation and enable near-unity spin-to-charge signal conversion. We consider a nonlocal spin-valve geometry in which a spin accumulation is injected into a superconductor and converted into a transverse charge signal through the inverse spin Hall effect. In the superconducting state, the strongly suppressed quasiparticle conductance below the gap allows the resulting charge imbalance to generate a voltage comparable to the injected spin bias, despite a small spin Hall angle. We derive the full nonequilibrium response including finite spectral broadening and finite temperature, and propose temperature and spin-bias-dependent measurements of the detector voltage to test our predictions.

full_list.title_en: Pseudo-Altermagnetism in Non-Hermitian Systems
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Pseudo-Altermagnetism in Non-Hermitian Systems
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29976v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Altermagnetism has attracted growing attention, and its analogs have been actively explored across classical platforms. Here, we introduce pseudo-altermagnetism in non-Hermitian systems, where balanced gain and loss plays the role of the altermagnetic spin, and the opposite gain and loss sublattices are related by an antiunitary symmetry O with Obm k≠ bm k for generic momentum bm k. Using a two-dimensional non-Hermitian system with O=C₄zT symmetry as a representative example, we find that pseudo-altermagnetism not only leads to a momentum-dependent gain and loss distribution analogous to the momentum-dependent spin splitting of altermagnets, but also exhibits intrinsic non-Hermitian properties. The bands of C₄zT-invariant non-Hermitian systems are either isolated or paired by C₄zT, and both cases are guaranteed to host movable but unremovable nodal structures, characterized by the zeros of two distinct quantities. An isolated band exhibits two movable but unremovable Hermitian spectral lines, whose generic points are not invariant under C₄zT, in sharp contrast to the conventional Hermitian spectra enforced only at the fixed points of an antiunitary symmetry. The paired bands, in turn, feature a movable but unremovable nodal network formed by the union of real-part and imaginary-part degeneracy lines, whose intersections are generally exceptional points. We further demonstrate these findings in a non-Hermitian photonic crystal. Our results establish a symmetry-based bridge between non-Hermitian physics and altermagnetism, and provide novel mechanisms of Hermitian spectra beyond PT symmetry.

full_list.title_en: Strain-driven terahertz phase modulation in piezoelectric and nonlinear optical crystals: mechanisms, material developments, and modulation strategies
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Strain-driven terahertz phase modulation in piezoelectric and nonlinear optical crystals: mechanisms, material developments, and modulation strategies
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30194v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Terahertz (THz) technology has witnessed notable developments in sensing, spectroscopy, imaging, and wireless communication which have increased the demand for high-performance THz modulators. Among the various approaches for controlling the THz waves, the application of external stimuli such as optical pumping and thermal or electric fields is widely employed as a promising strategy for modulation. This review focuses on recent advances in THz modulation based on different materials including 2D semiconductors and metamaterials with attention to their response under external stimuli. In addition, strain-driven THz modulation in non-centrosymmetric piezoelectric materials including organic and semi-organic crystals is examined with an emphasis on their ability to establish strong coupling between propagating THz waves and lattice vibrations under piezoelectric resonance conditions. We further highlight earlier reports on strain-driven THz modulation in lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and critically assess the potential of several other nonlinear optical crystals exhibiting piezoelectric resonance peaks suitable for strain-driven THz modulation. An overview of THz modulators integrated with tunable materials is presented highlighting their operating principles and key performance metrics comprising modulation speed, bandwidth, modulation depth and insertion loss.

full_list.title_en: Terahertz detection of magnon chirality in polycrystalline CsCuCl₃
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Terahertz detection of magnon chirality in polycrystalline CsCuCl₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30992v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In antiferromagnets, the handedness of magnon precession is usually measured on single crystals. In a pressed pellet of the chiral helimagnet CsCuCl₃, whose grains carry both structural handednesses and all orientations, we found that, from 5 to 7 T, the sub-terahertz magnon absorbs one circular polarization more than 20 times as strongly as the other, which rules out precession about each grain's own axis. Spin-wave theory attributes this to the Zeeman frequency, here two to four times the exchange-enhanced gap, which locks the precession axis to the field in every grain. Magnon chirality in antiferromagnets is thus accessible without a single crystal.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.05905v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A combination difference analysis of Fourier transform microwave spectroscopy (FTMW) measurements of ¹⁷⁴YbO combined with earlier near-infrared chemiluminescence data have resulted in much improved YbO rotational and centrifugal distortion constants. These have been confirmed in a multi-isotopologue analysis of further FTMW measurements of ¹⁷²YbO and ¹⁷⁶YbO and an analysis of nuclear-size-dependent Born-Oppenheimer breakdown effects in the molecule. Multiple excited electronic states overlap with low-lying excited vibrational levels of the electronic ground state leading to irregularities in its vibrational spacings and other previously observed electronic manifolds. This has been modeled with a matrix of the vibrational levels of the ground and multiple interacting states assuming Morse potentials and including electronic Hamiltonian matrix elements mixing the states. Vibrational level overlaps were calculated numerically assuming Morse vibrational wavefunctions. The resulting de-perturbed potentials for the states inform continuing experimental and theoretical work on this and other ytterbium-containing molecules.

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29928v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study demonstrates pyroelectric energy harvesting from a steady heat source using active piezoelectric thermal switching in a PZT/Si bimorph cantilever. The same PZT layer serves as both the mechanical actuator and the pyroelectric energy-conversion element. Dual output electrodes enable separation of the pyroelectric and piezoelectric signals. Pyroelectric energy harvesting is experimentally demonstrated at frequencies up to 110 Hz and temperature differences as small as 5 K. Comparison with the response predicted from the independently measured pyroelectric coefficient, together with transient thermal simulations, identifies dynamic interfacial heat transfer as a key limitation to high-frequency operation. This work demonstrates a compact MEMS approach for higher-frequency pyroelectric energy harvesting from low-grade steady heat sources.

full_list.title_en: Optical Motion Sensing for Piezoelectric-Resonator-Based Power Converters
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Optical Motion Sensing for Piezoelectric-Resonator-Based Power Converters
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29035v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Piezoelectric components present a promising alternative to conventional magnetics for miniaturized, high-frequency power converters. While high-Q piezoelectric resonators have demonstrated high efficiencies and large power densities in prototype high-frequency dc-dc converters, their optimal operating conditions are sensitive to temperature fluctuations and load variations. Therefore, robust closed-loop control is essential for practical deployment. Electrical approaches for sensing motional current may compromise the electrical isolation and electromagnetic interference (EMI) immunity inherently provided by the mechanical nature of these resonators. Here, we present an optical motion sensing approach for piezoelectric power converters. The optical sensing system comprises a laser, fiber optics, and a photodetector. The proposed approach uses optical interference to monitor the mechanical displacement in real time. The resulting optical signal carries both the amplitude and phase of the mechanical motion, which are necessary for closed-loop control. We experimentally characterize and validate this optical motion sensing approach using a 45-kHz piezoelectric resonator driven by a GaN half bridge with input voltages up to 45 V. We further experimentally demonstrate closed-loop control using the proposed optical motion sensing for a 99-kHz isolated piezoelectric converter. These initial results establish a viable pathway toward optically closed-loop control of piezoelectric power converters.

full_list.title_en: Antiferroelectric Fluids with Hierarchical Polar Organization
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Antiferroelectric Fluids with Hierarchical Polar Organization
full_list.abstract: The discovery of the ferroelectric nematic (NF) phase has accelerated research on fluids exhibiting polar order along the molecular long axis. However, their antiferroelectric (AFE) counterparts remain less explored. Here, we investigate how terminal alkyl-chain elongation competes with polar core–core interactions in a homologous series. This series exhibits modulated AFE order accompanied by SmC-type cybotactic correlations, with the AFE phase persisting in homologs bearing terminal alkyl chains of up to 17 carbon atoms. Three distinct phase sequences on cooling lead to two types of two-dimensional (2D) AFE lattices. Multiple sharp X-ray diffraction (XRD) peaks reveal rectangular and oblique lattice structures, supporting their classification as AFE columnar phases. XRD analysis and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations support a hierarchical structural model in which locally aligned polar molecules occupy thin segments of finite width within polar columns. The columns occupy the sites of a 2D lattice, with neighboring columns polarized in opposite directions. This model provides a structural framework for understanding the distinct precursor phase sequences and links packing between columns to the resulting AFE superstructures.

full_list.title_en: Multisite exchange paths and zigzag antiferromagnetism in the Kitaev material RuI3 monolayer
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Multisite exchange paths and zigzag antiferromagnetism in the Kitaev material RuI3 monolayer
full_list.abstract: Monolayer RuI3, with heavy ligands, is expected to host intriguing Kitaev physics. We derive its jeff=1/2 pseudospin model up to thethird-nearest neighbors (3NN) using exact diagonalization (ED) of N-site clusters (N=1--6), with crystal-field and hopping parameters from density functional theory and Wannier functions. Our results well explain the spin-orbital levels from resonant inelastic x-ray scattering experiments. We find that two-site calculations are insufficient, and multisite exchange via intermediate Ru sites is important. Therefore, we focus on six-site clusters that preserve the bond symmetry, and find that the exchange paths through one intermediate Ru site reduce the 1NN ferromagnetic Kitaev coupling but enhance the 3NN antiferromagnetic Heisenberg coupling, making the two comparable in strength. Their competition, together with sizable 1NN off-diagonal couplings, removes the Kitaev spinliquid and stabilizes zigzag antiferromagnetic order, as predicted by our 24-site ED and 72-site density-matrix renormalization group calculations.

full_list.title_en: Hybrid Constraint Generation for the Feedback Vertex Set Problem under QAOA
full_list.title_zh: QAOA下反馈顶点集问题的混合约束生成
full_list.abstract: The Feedback Vertex Set} (FVS) problem asks for a minimum-cardinality set of vertices whose removal makes a graph acyclic. A natural integer-programming formulation enforces one constraint per cycle, but enumerating all simple cycles quickly becomes a bottleneck when constructing QUBO and Ising Hamiltonians. We study undirected graphs and present a hybrid constraint-generation pipeline that starts from a compact minimum-cycle-basis encoding, uses the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA) as a heuristic candidate generator, and augments the constraint set only when the residual graph exposes a violated cycle. A lightweight classical verification and pruning stage ensures that the final reported solution is a valid FVS. The study centers on the tradeoff between compact encodings and explicit repair: minimum-cycle-basis constraints reduce binary-variable overhead, but they do not in general enforce all cycle-hitting inequalities, so an iterative augmentation loop remains necessary. We therefore frame the method as a hybrid constrained-optimization workflow rather than a claim of quantum advantage, and evaluate it through simulator-based case studies, exact classical references on small instances, and resource metrics that track constraint growth and slack-variable overhead.
full_list.abstract_zh: 反馈顶点集（FVS）问题要求顶点的最小基数集，将其删除会使图成为非循环。自然的整数规划公式对每个周期强制执行一个约束，但在构造 QUBO 和伊辛哈密顿量时，枚举所有简单周期很快就会成为瓶颈。我们研究无向图并提出一种混合约束生成管道，该管道从紧凑的最小循环基础编码开始，使用量子近似优化算法（QAOA）作为启发式候选生成器，并且仅当残差图暴露违反循环时才增加约束集。轻量级经典验证和修剪阶段确保最终报告的解决方案是有效的 FVS。

full_list.summary: 反馈顶点集（FVS）问题要求顶点的最小基数集，将其删除会使图成为非循环。自然的整数规划公式对每个周期强制执行一个约束，但在构造 QUBO 和伊辛哈密顿量时，枚举所有简单周期很快就会成为瓶颈。我们研究无向图并提出一种混合约束生成管道，该管道从紧凑的最小循环基础编码开始，使用量子近似优化算法（QAOA）作为启发式候选生成器，并且仅当残差图暴露违反循环时才增加约束集。轻量级经典验证和修剪阶段确保最终报告的解决方案是有效的 FVS。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《QAOA下反馈顶点集问题的混合约束生成》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

The technique uses inelastic neutron scattering to measure time-dependent two-point magnetization correlations, S(Q,ω), after resonant photoexcitation at cryogenic temperatures. full_list.title_en: A High-Frequency Flux-Driven DC-SQUID Threshold Detector at the Single-Microwave-Photon Energy Scale: A Numerical Feasibility Study
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A High-Frequency Flux-Driven DC-SQUID Threshold Detector at the Single-Microwave-Photon Energy Scale: A Numerical Feasibility Study
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In our recent work (Phys. Rev. B 113, 224503 (2026)), we showed numerically that rapidly sweeping the bias current of a current-biased Josephson junction threshold detector (CBJJ-JTD) drives it out of equilibrium. This substantially reduces the effect of thermal noise on microwave detection and may enable threshold detection near the energy of a single microwave photon. The scheme requires very low damping (β ≤ 10⁻⁴) and a very fast bias-current sweep (v/β ≥ 1), both of which are difficult to achieve with available junctions and low-pass-filtered cryogenic measurement lines. Here we propose a more experimentally accessible nonequilibrium threshold detector based on a high-frequency flux-driven direct-current superconducting quantum interference device (DC-SQUID) and investigate it by numerically solving the resistively and capacitively shunted junction (RCSJ) equations. The applied flux drives a circulating supercurrent and sustains nonequilibrium phase dynamics throughout the bias-current sweep, removing the need for a fast sweep or for transient oscillations set by the initial phase. Using typical experimental device parameters, we calculate switching-current distributions (SCDs) with and without a microwave input for both driven and undriven SQUIDs. We quantify detection performance using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves and their area under the curve (AUC). The simulations show that high-frequency flux drive reduces the impact of thermal noise and enables statistical discrimination of weak microwave pulses at the single-photon energy scale. We also numerically estimate detector characteristics such as phase selectivity and dynamic range.

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。

full_list.title_en: A Novel Algebraic Approach to Medium-Range Solvable Models
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Novel Algebraic Approach to Medium-Range Solvable Models
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29351v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We extend Jones' Baxterisation, which produces solutions to the Yang-Baxter equation directly from the generators of an algebra, to quantum spin chains with medium-range interactions. The key ingredient is an extended Yang-Baxter equation for R matrices that are built from the generators attached to two neighbouring sites. Together with the accompanying Lax operator, it gives rise to transfer matrices that are in involution up to boundary terms, exactly as in Jones' construction. We find a solution to the extended Yang-Baxter equation, of non-difference form, in terms of the generators of the chromatic algebra of 3-colouring, and obtain from it two families of medium-range lattice Hamiltonians. Thus, each representation of the algebra provides a medium-range solvable model. Using the relation between the chromatic algebra of 3-colouring and the fusion category Rep(S₃), we construct four such representations. They reproduce the folded XXZ model and the hard-rod deformed XXZ model, and give new medium-range models of a three-state antiferromagnet and of a Rydberg-blockade ladder. Two of the four models possess non-invertible symmetries.

full_list.title_en: A Theoretical Investigation of Magnetic Susceptibility Measurement of Diamagnetic Liquids Using a Michelson Interferometer
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Theoretical Investigation of Magnetic Susceptibility Measurement of Diamagnetic Liquids Using a Michelson Interferometer
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.29671v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We examine the theoretical use of a Michelson interferometer to infer the magnetic susceptibility of a diamagnetic liquid from a magnetically induced surface deformation. A ring magnet changes the liquid thickness along the sample beam, producing a signed phase shift relative to a fixed optical reference. For a double traversal of the sample, the fringe displacement is m = 2(nₑₗₗ - nₐ)Δ z/λ. We derive the susceptibility inversion both in a local gravity approximation and with surface tension included through the linearized Young-Laplace equation. The treatment distinguishes a finite reference field from a zero-field reference, specifies the displacement sign and susceptibility contrast, and identifies calibration and uncertainty requirements. Reproducible illustrative calculations use a uniformly magnetized annulus. The results establish a theoretical measurement relation and its assumptions; they do not constitute an experimental demonstration or a verified accuracy claim.

full_list.title_en: Anomalous Field-induced Coherence beyond Single-ion Kondo Physics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Anomalous Field-induced Coherence beyond Single-ion Kondo Physics
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.31137v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The emergence of coherent heavy quasiparticles in Kondo lattices is generally accompanied by a reduction in electrical resistivity at low temperatures. However, certain strongly correlated metals exhibit anomalously large resistivities that persist to very low temperatures, raising fundamental questions about the mechanisms governing charge transport. Here, we report an unusual magnetic field-induced evolution of electronic transport and thermodynamic properties in a Ce-based heavy fermion compound, Ce₂Rh₃Ga₅. At zero field, Ce₂Rh₃Ga₅ undergoes a magnetic transition at T₀ = 0.45 K and exhibits a strongly enhanced low temperature specific heat coefficient, reaching C/T = 2.2 J/molCₑ-K², but no discernible coherence in its electrical resistivity. Remarkably, applying a magnetic field produces a large negative magnetoresistance and restores coherent metallic behavior, characterized by low-temperature T² resistivity. Although the field dependence of the electronic specific heat coefficient can be described phenomenologically within a single-ion Kondo framework, the same description fails to account for the strong suppression of the residual resistivity and the overall magnetoresistance. These results point to an additional field-sensitive scattering contribution beyond conventional single-ion Kondo physics. The striking resemblance to the long-standing anomalous magnetotransport behavior of UBe₁₃, without the complications introduced by superconductivity, establishes Ce₂Rh₃Ga₅ as a platform for investigating the microscopic origin of anomalous scattering and field-induced coherent transport in strongly correlated electron systems.

full_list.title_en: Asymmetrical transport distribution function: skewness as a key to enhance thermoelectric performance
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Asymmetrical transport distribution function: skewness as a key to enhance thermoelectric performance
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30565v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How to achieve high thermoelectric figure of merit is still a scientific challenge. By solving the Boltzmann transport equation, thermoelectric properties can be written as integrals of a single function, the transport distribution function (TDF). In this work, the shape effects of transport distribution function in various typical functional forms on thermoelectric properties of materials are systematically investigated. It is found that the asymmetry of TDF, characterized by skewness, can be used to describe universally the trend of thermoelectric properties. By defining symmetric and asymmetric TDF functions, a novel skewness is then constructed for thermoelectric applications. It is demonstrated, by comparison with ab initio calculations and experiments, that the proposed thermoelectric skewness not only perfectly captures the main feature of conventional skewness, but also is able to predict the thermoelectric power accurately. This comparison confirms the unique feature of our proposed thermoelectric skewness, as well as its special role of connection between the statistics of TDF and thermoelectric properties of materials. It is also found that the thermoelectric performance can be enhanced by increasing the asymmetry of TDF. Finally, it is also interesting to find that the thermoelectric transport properties based on typical quantum statistics (Fermi-Dirac distributions), can be well described by typical shape parameter (skewness) for classical statistics.

full_list.title_en: Charge-fluctuation hot lines and superconductivity in Ba₁₋ₓKₓBiO₃
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Charge-fluctuation hot lines and superconductivity in Ba₁₋ₓKₓBiO₃
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28879v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The origin of superconductivity near 30~K in Ba₀.₆K₀.₄BiO₃ has remained a long-standing puzzle. Tunneling experiments give an electron--boson coupling λapprox 0.7--1.2, whereas density-functional calculations give λapprox 0.3, concentrated in the breathing mode near 50--70~meV. We propose that the missing coupling of about 0.7 comes from dynamical charge fluctuations at Q=(pi,pi,pi)/a, the ordering vector of the charge-disproportionated parent compound, and introduce an overdamped boson model to describe them. Using a tight-binding fit to the conduction band found from density-functional calculations at x=0.4, we show that such a boson scatters electrons strongly only on hot lines of the Fermi surface, small loops around the langle 111rangle directions where k and k+Q are both at the Fermi level. We derive closed-form self-energies, quasiparticle residues and band reconstructions, including shadow bands and hot-line pseudogaps for long-range correlations, and show that a sum rule fixes the Fermi-surface-averaged coupling independently of the boson frequency and correlation length. Combining the LDA phonon with an overdamped mode of frequency ωₘapprox 25~meV and coupling λapprox 0.7, anisotropic Eliashberg calculations reproduce T_capprox 25--30~K for correlation lengths of two to three lattice spacings and predict a gap enhanced by a factor of 3--4 on the hot loops. For longer correlation lengths an s-wave state competes closely with a sign-changing T₂g state confined to the hot loops. In the random-phase approximation for an extended Hubbard model, the boson emerges naturally near a charge instability at R, but purely electronic fluctuations are too weak and too long-ranged; coupling to the breathing-mode lattice distortion is one possible way to strengthen them.

full_list.title_en: Competing magnetic correlations in the square-lattice Hubbard model with spin-dependent nearest-neighbor and next-nearest-neighbor hopping
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Competing magnetic correlations in the square-lattice Hubbard model with spin-dependent nearest-neighbor and next-nearest-neighbor hopping
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28593v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets have spin-split bands without net magnetization. The splitting can come from a spin-dependent nearest-neighbor (NN) hopping anisotropy t_A or from a spin-dependent next-nearest-neighbor (NNN) hopping t'. Both change sign under a 90^circ rotation and are present together when the lattice has no mirror planes, yet they have so far been studied only separately. Here we study the two-dimensional square-lattice Hubbard model with both t_A and t', using constrained-path quantum Monte Carlo at U=4t and scanning the electron filling n, t_A and t'. We find four types of magnetic correlations: Néel, stripe, diagonal, and spiral spin-density-wave. The phase diagram depends on both hoppings together. Diagonal correlations require finite t_A and are suppressed by t'. Stripe correlations appear only once t' is large enough to overcome the diagonal tendency set by t_A. Néel correlations survive at large t_A and large t', where the NNN model alone gives stripe or spiral correlations. The noninteracting susceptibility matches the dominant wavevector at small t', but not the Néel correlations at t'≥0.3, which come from the interaction. Finite-size scaling with three lattice sizes is consistent with long-range order only near half filling; at the stripe, spiral and diagonal points we tested, the structure factor per site extrapolates to zero. The joint behavior persists up to U=6t.

full_list.title_en: Critical Topology: A New Perspective for Phase Transitions
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Critical Topology: A New Perspective for Phase Transitions
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.30368v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Critical topology has emerged as a form of quantum criticality beyond the Landau paradigm, challenging conventional approaches to classifying universality classes by introducing topological properties as an additional criterion. Despite substantial progress over the past five years, several fundamental questions remain open. Theoretically, can we establish a general criterion for the emergence of critical topology? Can a unified theoretical framework be extended beyond one-dimensional quantum many-body systems? What efficient numerical methods can be developed to investigate critical topological states in higher-dimensional strongly correlated systems? Experimentally, research has so far focused primarily on single-particle critical topology. An important next step is to realize and characterize many-body critical topology in quantum systems using platforms such as Rydberg atom arrays, superconducting quantum processors, and quantum materials. Major advances in statistical physics often arise from re-examining fundamental concepts. The theory of critical phenomena developed by Landau, Ginzburg, and Wilson, together with the topological phase transitions pioneered by Kosterlitz and Thouless, has now inspired new discoveries in artificial acoustic metamaterials. These experimental observations mark a beginning rather than an endpoint for research on critical topology, and further advances in this direction are anticipated.

full_list.title_en: Defect Engineering of the Water-Carbon Interface: Insights from First-Principles Calculations
full_list.title_zh: 水-碳界面的缺陷工程：第一性原理计算的见解
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2611.28201v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interactions at solid-liquid interfaces are fundamental to hydrovoltaic and catalytic technologies. While carbon nanomaterials have been extensively studied, the role of abundant defects in amorphous carbon remains poorly understood. Here, using first-principles calculations, we systematically investigate how various defects (topological, point, line, edge, and doping defects) modulate water-carbon interactions. We find that armchair-edge defects with dangling bonds reduce the energy barrier for water dissociation by up to 30 times compared with pristine carbon, while di-vacancies exhibit a near-zero Gibbs free energy for hydrogen evolution, enabling potential hydrogen evolution reaction activity on a purely carbon-based interface. Moreover, mono-vacancy defects, characterized by reduced electronic localization, enhance charge transfer to evaporating water molecules by up to 12.4 times, a key factor in evaporation-induced electricity generation. Crucially, we demonstrate that coupling distinct defects produces synergistic effects that outperform individual defects, revealing a promising strategy for designing multifunctional interfaces. These insights establish a defect-engineering framework for the rational design of high-efficiency hydrovoltaic and catalytic devices.
full_list.abstract_zh: 固液界面的相互作用是水力发电和催化技术的基础。尽管碳纳米材料已被广泛研究，但对无定形碳中大量缺陷的作用仍知之甚少。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，系统地研究了各种缺陷（拓扑缺陷、点缺陷、线缺陷、边缘缺陷和掺杂缺陷）如何调节水-碳相互作用。我们发现，与原始碳相比，具有悬空键的扶手椅边缘缺陷将水解离的能垒降低了多达 30 倍，而双空位则表现出接近于零的析氢吉布斯自由能，从而在纯碳基界面上实现了潜在的析氢反应活性。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 固液界面的相互作用是水力发电和催化技术的基础。尽管碳纳米材料已被广泛研究，但对无定形碳中大量缺陷的作用仍知之甚少。在这里，我们利用第一性原理计算，系统地研究了各种缺陷（拓扑缺陷、点缺陷、线缺陷、边缘缺陷和掺杂缺陷）如何调节水-碳相互作用。我们发现，与原始碳相比，具有悬空键的扶手椅边缘缺陷将水解离的能垒降低了多达 30 倍，而双空位则表现出接近于零的析氢吉布斯自由能，从而在纯碳基界面上实现了潜在的析氢反应活性。此外，以电子局域化减少为特征的单空位缺陷可将蒸发水分子的电荷转移增强高达 12.4 倍，这是蒸发诱导发电的关键因素。至关重要的是，我们证明耦合不同的缺陷会产生优于单个缺陷的协同效应，揭示了设计多功能界面的有前途的策略。这些见解为高效水力发电和催化装置的合理设计建立了缺陷工程框架。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：第一性原理标注与结构优化, 自由能面和热力学积分/采样，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《水-碳界面的缺陷工程：第一性原理计算的见解》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

research_direction_note: 本日文献与团队研究的交集主要集中在有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量、热力学自由能、相稳定与有限温度建模、自由能面和热力学积分/采样、等变神经网络与对称性保持表示，并落到铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程、晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系、缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学、声子、有限温度和输运性质。对现有工作最直接的价值是提供可复用的表示、采样或验证流程，而不是替代具体材料体系的物理判断。后续筛选应优先核对原文数据是否包含结构、能量、力、应力、极化、自旋或有限温度轨迹，再决定是否迁移到铁电、磁性、缺陷和外场驱动模拟。

core_items.title_en: Graph Neural Networks for Accurate Quasiparticle Energy Levels in Large Supercells of Transition Metal Dichalcogenides
core_items.title_zh: 过渡金属二硫化物大型超晶胞中精确准粒子能级的图神经网络
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.29349v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The GW method is the one of the main workhorses of the materials science community to accurately calculate the electronic bandgap of materials, as it overcomes the gap underestimation problem from Density Functional Theory (DFT). Despite its accuracy, its computational cost becomes prohibitive when calculations have more than 10-100 atoms, which makes more difficult its use for defects, surfaces and moiré systems that demand large supercells. To overcome this problem, we developed a Graph Neural Network trained with smaller GW calculations which can make accurate predictions on large supercells at a small fraction of the computational cost. Our model uses as features the projection of DFT wavefunctions into localized atomic orbitals, while graph nodes represent the atomic positions and edges represent atom to atom distances, which captures the system geometry. We explore how to do "small AI", providing a workflow of how to create a personal and convenient dataset of GW calculations to train the model that can be applied to different materials so that the final user does not need to rely on massive datasets. We define what must be included in the training dataset to capture the physics of our objective simulation, and perform a Bayesian optimization of hyperparameters. In the case of monolayer MoS₂ with a sulfur vacancy our GNN models achieve high accuracy (MAE ranging 10 to 50 meV) with a simplified workflow applicable to other materials, accelerating accurate large electronic structure calculations.
core_items.abstract_zh: GW 方法是材料科学界精确计算材料电子带隙的主要工具之一，因为它克服了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的带隙低估问题。尽管其准确性很高，但当计算原子数超过 10-100 时，其计算成本就会变得过高，这使得其在需要大型超级晶胞的缺陷、表面和莫尔系统中的使用变得更加困难。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了一个用较小的 GW 计算训练的图神经网络，它可以以很小的计算成本对大型超级细胞进行准确的预测。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: GW 方法是材料科学界精确计算材料电子带隙的主要工具之一，因为它克服了密度泛函理论 (DFT) 的带隙低估问题。尽管其准确性很高，但当计算原子数超过 10-100 时，其计算成本就会变得过高，这使得其在需要大型超级晶胞的缺陷、表面和莫尔系统中的使用变得更加困难。为了克服这个问题，我们开发了一个用较小的 GW 计算训练的图神经网络，它可以以很小的计算成本对大型超级细胞进行准确的预测。我们的模型使用 DFT 波函数到局部原子轨道的投影作为特征，而图节点表示原子位置，边表示原子到原子的距离，从而捕获系统几何形状。我们探索如何做“小AI”，提供了如何创建个性化且方便的GW计算数据集来训练可应用于不同材料的模型的工作流程，以便最终用户不需要依赖海量数据集。我们定义训练数据集中必须包含的内容，以捕获目标模拟的物理原理，并对超参数执行贝叶斯优化。对于具有硫空位的单层 MoS2，我们的 GNN 模型可通过适用于其他材料的简化工作流程实现高精度（MAE 范围为 10 至 50 meV），从而加速精确的大型电子结构计算。

core_items.title_en: Machine Learning Electronic Hamiltonian with Long-Range Effects and External Fields
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Machine Learning Electronic Hamiltonian with Long-Range Effects and External Fields
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.28450v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conventional machine-learning electronic Hamiltonian (MLEH) models rely on a local-environment approximation and can miss the effects of long-range (LR) interactions and external fields. Here, we introduce MLEH-LR, a framework that incorporates these effects into Hamiltonian prediction. Benchmarks across materials with different polarizations and dimensionalities demonstrate substantial improvements in the accuracy of the predicted Hamiltonians and resulting electronic structures. MLEH-LR enables accurate, large-scale, high-throughput electronic-structure calculations, as demonstrated for zigzag boron nitride ribbons under transverse electric fields. These calculations allow us to formulate a quantitative relation describing the joint width and field dependence of the band gap and to reveal the electronic mechanisms underlying its field response. Our work provides an efficient method and tool for studying electronic structure in materials where long-range electrostatics and external fields play an important role.

core_items.title_en: AmorphGen: A Python package for amorphous structure generation with machine-learning and classical interatomic potentials
core_items.title_zh: AmorphGen：利用机器学习和经典原子间势生成非晶结构的 Python 包
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.29539v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AmorphGen is an open-source Python package for generating and analyzing amorphous structures from a composition or a crystal. Chemically informed rules estimate initial densities and assign separation and coordination constraints. Three routes are available: random placement followed by relaxation, melt-quench from a crystal, and a hybrid route that anneals and quenches random structures. ASE provides access to classical and machine-learning potentials, with GPU batching for selected backends. Analysis tools compute coordination numbers, bond angles, rings, and X-ray or neutron structure factors for comparison with measurements. An optional interface to the FEFF code computes extended X-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS) spectra. For amorphous Ga2O3, TiO2 and InGaZnO4, the cation coordination numbers are close to reference models and measurements, and the X-ray structure factors reproduce the main measured peaks. The EXAFS spectra for Ga2O3 and InGaZnO4 also capture the dominant first-shell features observed experimentally. The hybrid route reduces bonding defects in SiO2 and As and builds the first sharp diffraction peak of SiO2. By simplifying ensemble generation and standardizing structural assessment, AmorphGen makes it practical to compare amorphous models across compositions, potentials, and preparation routes, and to screen new amorphous compositions.
core_items.abstract_zh: AmorphGen 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成和分析组合物或晶体的无定形结构。化学信息规则估计初始密度并分配分离和配位约束。有三种途径可供选择：随机放置然后松弛、晶体熔融淬火以及对随机结构进行退火和淬火的混合途径。 ASE 提供对经典和机器学习潜力的访问，并为选定的后端提供 GPU 批处理。分析工具计算配位数、键角、环和 X 射线或中子结构因子，以便与测量结果进行比较。 FEFF 代码的可选接口可计算扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 光谱。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: AmorphGen 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成和分析组合物或晶体的无定形结构。化学信息规则估计初始密度并分配分离和配位约束。有三种途径可供选择：随机放置然后松弛、晶体熔融淬火以及对随机结构进行退火和淬火的混合途径。 ASE 提供对经典和机器学习潜力的访问，并为选定的后端提供 GPU 批处理。分析工具计算配位数、键角、环和 X 射线或中子结构因子，以便与测量结果进行比较。 FEFF 代码的可选接口可计算扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 光谱。对于非晶 Ga2O3、TiO2 和 InGaZnO4，阳离子配位数接近参考模型和测量结果，X 射线结构因子再现了主要测量峰。 Ga2O3 和 InGaZnO4 的 EXAFS 光谱也捕获了实验观察到的主要第一壳层特征。该混合路线减少了 SiO2 和 As 中的键合缺陷，并建立了 SiO2 的第一个尖锐衍射峰。通过简化系综生成和标准化结构评估，AmorphGen 使得比较不同成分、电位和制备路线的非晶态模型以及筛选新的非晶态成分变得切实可行。
core_items.summary: AmorphGen 是一个开源 Python 包，用于生成和分析组合物或晶体的无定形结构。化学信息规则估计初始密度并分配分离和配位约束。有三种途径可供选择：随机放置然后松弛、晶体熔融淬火以及对随机结构进行退火和淬火的混合途径。 ASE 提供对经典和机器学习潜力的访问，并为选定的后端提供 GPU 批处理。分析工具计算配位数、键角、环和 X 射线或中子结构因子，以便与测量结果进行比较。 FEFF 代码的可选接口可计算扩展 X 射线吸收精细结构 (EXAFS) 光谱。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《AmorphGen：利用机器学习和经典原子间势生成非晶结构的 Python 包》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Learning free energy across a differentiable temperature range by deep generative modeling
core_items.title_zh: 通过深度生成模型学习可微分温度范围内的自由能
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.28810v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Free energy governs the directionality, stability, and temperature sensitivity of physical, chemical, and biological transformations. Conventional free energy calculations, such as thermodynamic integration and free energy perturbation, often have to be performed at individual temperatures and are limited by the high cost of sampling an extensive set of thermodynamic states. Here, we introduce learned temperature-differentiable free energy perturbation (TD-FEP), a deep generative framework that learns a temperature-conditioned, invertible mapping between reference and target systems through data-free, energy-based optimization. TD-FEP thereby unifies one-shot state generation and free energy calculation across a continuous temperature range. We validated TD-FEP across a broad range of applications, including isolated molecules, periodic materials, and chemical reactions.

Here, we introduce learned temperature-differentiable free energy perturbation (TD-FEP), a deep generative framework that learns a temperature-conditioned, invertible mapping between reference and target systems through data-free, energy-based optimization.因此，TD-FEP 统一了连续温度范围内的一次性状态生成和自由能计算。我们在广泛的应用中验证了 TD-FEP，包括孤立分子、周期性材料和化学反应。

core_items.title_en: Origin of Reduced Coercive Field in ScAlN: Synergy of Structural Softening and Dynamic Atomic Correlations
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Origin of Reduced Coercive Field in ScAlN: Synergy of Structural Softening and Dynamic Atomic Correlations
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2603.18710v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Among wurtzite-type ferroelectrics, scandium-doped aluminum nitride (ScAlN) has emerged as a leading candidate for CMOS-compatible low-voltage memory, combining strong spontaneous polarization with process compatibility. A remarkable feature of this system is the pronounced reduction of the coercive field (E_c) with increasing Sc concentration; however, its microscopic origin remains poorly understood at the atomic scale, particularly under finite temperature and applied electric fields. Here, we employ an atomistic simulation framework that integrates a density-functional-theory-accurate machine-learning force field with an equivariant neural-network-based Born effective charge model to perform large-scale electric-field-induced molecular dynamics simulations at near-first-principles accuracy. The framework correctly reproduces key experimentally observed trends, including the decrease in the c/a ratio and the monotonic reduction of E_c with increasing Sc content. Beyond static structural softening, we uncover a dynamic mechanism underlying E_c reduction. Sc atoms exhibit larger thermal vibrations and begin to displace earlier during switching, acting as dynamic triggers for polarization reversal. Moreover, the displacement correlation between Sc and Al atoms evolves systematically with composition, enhancing cooperative atomic rearrangements and lowering the effective switching barrier. These results demonstrate that E_c reduction in ScAlN arises from the synergy of structural softening and dynamic correlation evolution, providing a new perspective for designing hexagonal ferroelectrics.

core_items.title_en: A Fractional Chern Semimetal: Exact Wavefunction and Conformal Criticality
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：A Fractional Chern Semimetal: Exact Wavefunction and Conformal Criticality
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.31234v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Unlike fractional quantum Hall states in uniform Landau levels, fractional Chern insulators can host dispersive anyon bands, raising the question of what happens when the anyon gap closes. We construct an exact finite-bond-dimension tensor-network state for a fractional Chern semimetal by Gutzwiller projecting a critical parton state. This state exhibits divergent correlation lengths in charged sectors but a fractionally quantized many-body Chern number of 1/3. Although it has one electron per unit cell, its modular S and T matrices and entanglement spectrum match those of the ν=1/3 Laughlin state. We identify a (1+1)--dimensional U(3)₁× SU(3)₁ conformal field theory (CFT) governing the wavefunction norm in the infrared, an unexpected result for a state with U(1)₃ topology. The SU(3)₁ sector is a nonlinear sigma model whose Wess--Zumino level and kinetic stiffness are determined by the parton Chern number and Fubini--Study metric, respectively. Under renormalization, it flows to the conformal fixed point, with an initial distance to this fixed point controlled by the idealness of parton quantum geometry. Favorable geometry enables precise agreement with CFT predictions even on narrow cylinders.

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《A Fractional Chern Semimetal: Exact Wavefunction and Conformal Criticality》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Dirac-like bands and weak-field transverse transport in ABA trilayer graphene
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Dirac-like bands and weak-field transverse transport in ABA trilayer graphene
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2611.30924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The low-energy electronic structure of ABA trilayer graphene is composed of light and heavy electron branches, which can be altered by an out-of-plane displacement field. Here, we show that, depending on the values of Slonczewski-Weiss-McClure parameters, a displacement field can inflict a band edge inversion, for which we identify the inversion conditions. This inversion is accompanied by a reversal of Berry curvature and giant topological magnetic moments at the band edges. In a weak perpendicular magnetic field, those topological magnetic moments produce valley splitting, giving rise to distinct anomalous transverse electrical and thermoelectric responses. These features offer a potential route to detecting the band inversion and constraining several of the least established tight-binding parameters, such as the on-site energy shift for the dimer pair of carbons Δ^prime and the next neighbour hopping parameters γ₂ and γ₅.

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 声子、有限温度和输运性质在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《Dirac-like bands and weak-field transverse transport in ABA trilayer graphene》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：High-temperature superconductivity from kinetic energy
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2411.07292v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Superconductivity is usually assumed to arise from attractive interaction. In this work we show that strong pairing is possible soley from kinetic energy even without a net attraction. We demonstrate a high-temperature kinetic superconductor in a simple lattice model with nearest-neighbor hopping (t) projected onto a constrained Hilbert space, analogous to the t-J model with J=0, where kinetic magnetism has been previously studied. Using density matrix renormalization group (DMRG) on cylinders up to width L_y=8, we find a superconducting ground state exhibiting a key difference from high-T_c cuprates: both the pairing gap and phase stiffness increase with doping (x). We find pairing gaps, determined from spin and single-electron charge gaps, exceeding 1.5t. This model can be realized within the double Kondo lattice model, relevant to bilayer nickelates, in the limit of strong inter-layer spin coupling (J_perp/t → +infty) and a balancing inter-layer repulsion (V). Importantly, the double Kondo model does not fundamentally restrict J_perp/t, suggesting the potential for high critical temperatures (T_c) approaching 0.5t. While this idealized limit predicts large pairing gaps, we show a smooth connection to the more realistic regime with J_perp sim t, albeit with a reduced pairing gap of approximately 0.1t. Assuming t sim 10³ K in typical solid state systems, our model suggests the exciting possibility of achieving T_c of hundreds of Kelvin. We propose searching for bilayer materials with reduced out-of-plane lattice constants to better approximate the conditions of our ideal model.
